```SNOBOL4
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// porter.sno — Porter (1980) stemming algorithm in SNOBOL4
*//
*// Faithful translation of the Python PATTERN version from CSCE-5200 Project 1, which uses the
*// snobol4python library (SNOBOL4python 0.5.2).  The snobol4python-to-SPITBOL primitive map is:
*//
*//   Python (snobol4python)       SNOBOL4 (SPITBOL)
*//   ──────────────────────       ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
*//   POS(0) / RPOS(0)             POS(0) / RPOS(0)
*//   RTAB(n)                      RTAB(n)
*//   σ('sses')                    'sses'
*//   P @ "var"                    P $ var          (immediate — at match time; used for guards)
*//   P % "var"                    P . var          (conditional — on commit; used to keep text)
*//   Λ(callable)                  *pred_fn()       (pattern-valued fn: '' = ok, FAIL = nope)
*//   λ("stmt")                    (epsilon . *action_fn())   (deferred commit-time side effect)
*//   A | B                        A | B
*//   A + B                        A B              (juxtaposition = concatenation)
*//
*// Oracle: SPITBOL x64 (/home/claude/x64/bin/sbl).  Test fixture: voc.txt / output.txt from
*// tartarus.org/martin/PorterStemmer (23,531 words).
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

               &ANCHOR        =  0
               &FULLSCAN      =  1
               epsilon        =

               VOWELS         =  'aeiou'
               LC             =  'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// cons(i): true if stem[i] is a consonant.  Letters 1-indexed (SNOBOL4 SUBSTR is 1-based).
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('cons(i)c')                                   :(cons_end)
cons           c              =  SUBSTR(stem, i, 1)
               c              ANY(VOWELS)                          :S(FRETURN)
               DIFFER(c, 'y')                                       :S(RETURN)
               EQ(i, 1)                                             :S(RETURN)
               cons(i - 1)                                          :S(FRETURN)F(RETURN)
cons_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// m(): Porter's measure — the number of VC sequences in 'stem'.  Returns integer.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('m()i,n,L')                                   :(m_end)
m              L              =  SIZE(stem)
               EQ(L, 0)                                             :S(RETURN)
               i              =  1
               n              =  0
mC0            GT(i, L)                                             :S(RETURN)
               cons(i)                                              :F(mV1)
               i              =  i + 1                              :(mC0)
mV1            i              =  i + 1
mV             GT(i, L)                                             :S(RETURN)
               cons(i)                                              :S(mC1)
               i              =  i + 1                              :(mV)
mC1            i              =  i + 1
               n              =  n + 1
               m              =  n
mC             GT(i, L)                                             :S(RETURN)
               cons(i)                                              :F(mV1)
               i              =  i + 1                              :(mC)
m_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// vowelinstem(): true if any char of stem is a vowel (y after consonant counts).
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('vowelinstem()i,L')                           :(vis_end)
vowelinstem    L              =  SIZE(stem)
               i              =  1
visL           GT(i, L)                                             :S(FRETURN)
               cons(i)                                              :F(RETURN)
               i              =  i + 1                              :(visL)
vis_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// doublec(j): stem[j] == stem[j-1] and both consonants.  j 1-based.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('doublec(j)')                                 :(dc_end)
doublec        LT(j, 2)                                             :S(FRETURN)
               DIFFER(SUBSTR(stem, j, 1), SUBSTR(stem, j - 1, 1))   :S(FRETURN)
               cons(j)                                              :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
dc_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// cvc(i): stem[i-2..i] = c-v-c  and  stem[i] not in {w,x,y}.  i 1-based.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('cvc(i)c')                                    :(cvc_end)
cvc            LT(i, 3)                                             :S(FRETURN)
               cons(i)                                              :F(FRETURN)
               cons(i - 1)                                          :S(FRETURN)
               cons(i - 2)                                          :F(FRETURN)
               c              =  SUBSTR(stem, i, 1)
               c              ANY('wxy')                           :S(FRETURN)F(RETURN)
cvc_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// Guards — pattern-valued.  Return null pattern ('') on success, FAIL on failure.
*// Called as *gX() inside a pattern.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('g_vis()')                                    :(g_vis_end)
g_vis          vowelinstem()                                        :F(gv_no)
               g_vis          =                                     :(RETURN)
gv_no          g_vis          =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_vis_end

               DEFINE('g_m_gt_0()')                                 :(g_m0_end)
g_m_gt_0       GT(m(), 0)                                           :F(gm0_no)
               g_m_gt_0       =                                     :(RETURN)
gm0_no         g_m_gt_0       =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_m0_end

               DEFINE('g_m_gt_1()')                                 :(g_m1_end)
g_m_gt_1       GT(m(), 1)                                           :F(gm1_no)
               g_m_gt_1       =                                     :(RETURN)
gm1_no         g_m_gt_1       =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_m1_end

               DEFINE('g_m_eq_1()')                                 :(g_me1_end)
g_m_eq_1       EQ(m(), 1)                                           :F(gme1_no)
               g_m_eq_1       =                                     :(RETURN)
gme1_no        g_m_eq_1       =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_me1_end

               DEFINE('g_not_cvc_last()L')                          :(g_ncvc_end)
g_not_cvc_last L              =  SIZE(stem)
               cvc(L)                                               :S(gnc_no)
               g_not_cvc_last =                                     :(RETURN)
gnc_no         g_not_cvc_last =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_ncvc_end

               DEFINE('g_stem_not_m()L')                            :(g_snm_end)
g_stem_not_m   L              =  SIZE(stem)
               DIFFER(SUBSTR(stem, L, 1), 'm')                      :F(gsnm_no)
               g_stem_not_m   =                                     :(RETURN)
gsnm_no        g_stem_not_m   =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_snm_end

               DEFINE('g_stem_last_st()L,last')                     :(g_sls_end)
g_stem_last_st L              =  SIZE(stem)
               last           =  SUBSTR(stem, L, 1)
               last           ANY('st')                            :F(gsls_no)
               g_stem_last_st =                                     :(RETURN)
gsls_no        g_stem_last_st =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_sls_end

               DEFINE('g_m_ll_gt_1()save,r')                        :(g_mll_end)
g_m_ll_gt_1    save           =  stem
               stem           =  save 'll'
               r              =  m()
               stem           =  save
               GT(r, 1)                                             :F(gmll_no)
               g_m_ll_gt_1    =                                     :(RETURN)
gmll_no        g_m_ll_gt_1    =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_mll_end
```

## benchmark_calculator-1-match-fence

```SNOBOL4
        &TRIM   =  0
        I       =  SPAN('0123456789')
        V       =  ANY(&LCASE)
        A       =  FENCE(I | V | '(' *X ')')
        F       =  FENCE('+' *F | '-' *F | A)
        T       =  FENCE(F '*' *T | F '/' *T | F)
        X       =  FENCE(T '+' *X | T '-' *X | T)
        C       =  POS(0) ARBNO(X CHAR(10)) RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* CALCULATOR_1_MATCH_FENCE(N) -- run the recognizer N times over the slurped source and report the
* number of bytes it matched.  N=1 is what the standalone driver below asks for;
* the timed twin built by scripts/bench_wrap.sh asks for many.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DEFINE('CALCULATOR_1_MATCH_FENCE(N)')  :(CALCULATOR_1_MATCH_FENCE_END)
CALCULATOR_1_MATCH_FENCE  ZI = 1
ZBL     src ? C  :F(ZBAD)
        ZI = LT(ZI, N) ZI + 1  :S(ZBL)
        CALCULATOR_1_MATCH_FENCE = 'matched bytes=' SIZE(src)  :(RETURN)
ZBAD    CALCULATOR_1_MATCH_FENCE = 'Pattern match failed'  :(RETURN)
CALCULATOR_1_MATCH_FENCE_END
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
        src = INPUT
*BENCH kernel=CALCULATOR_1_MATCH_FENCE check=1 bud=1000 flr=20
        OUTPUT = CALCULATOR_1_MATCH_FENCE(1)
END
```

```stdout
matched bytes=0
```

## benchmark_calculator-2-match-fence

```SNOBOL4
        V              =  ANY('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
        I              =  SPAN('0123456789')
        A              =  FENCE(V | I | '(' *X ')')
        F              =  FENCE(A | ANY('+-') *F)
        T              =  F ARBNO(ANY('*/') F)
        X              =  T ARBNO(ANY('+-') T)
        eol            =  CHAR(10)
        C              =  POS(0) ARBNO(X eol) RPOS(0)
        &TRIM          =  0
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* CALCULATOR_2_MATCH_FENCE(N) -- run the recognizer N times over the slurped source and report the
* number of bytes it matched.  N=1 is what the standalone driver below asks for;
* the timed twin built by scripts/bench_wrap.sh asks for many.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DEFINE('CALCULATOR_2_MATCH_FENCE(N)')  :(CALCULATOR_2_MATCH_FENCE_END)
CALCULATOR_2_MATCH_FENCE  ZI = 1
ZBL     src C  :F(ZBAD)
        ZI = LT(ZI, N) ZI + 1  :S(ZBL)
        CALCULATOR_2_MATCH_FENCE = 'matched bytes=' SIZE(src)  :(RETURN)
ZBAD    CALCULATOR_2_MATCH_FENCE = 'Pattern match failed'  :(RETURN)
CALCULATOR_2_MATCH_FENCE_END
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
        src = INPUT
*BENCH kernel=CALCULATOR_2_MATCH_FENCE check=1 bud=1000 flr=20
        OUTPUT = CALCULATOR_2_MATCH_FENCE(1)
END
```

## benchmark_claws5-match

```SNOBOL4
        &TRIM   =   0
        claws   =   POS(0)
+                   ARBNO(
+                     ( (SPAN('0123456789')) '_CRD :_PUN'
+                     | (NOTANY('_') BREAK('_'))
+                       '_'
+                       (ANY(&UCASE) SPAN('0123456789' &UCASE))
+                     )
+                     SPAN(' ' CHAR(10))
+                   )
+                   RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* CLAWS5_MATCH(N) -- run the recognizer N times over the slurped source and report the
* number of bytes it matched.  N=1 is what the standalone driver below asks for;
* the timed twin built by scripts/bench_wrap.sh asks for many.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DEFINE('CLAWS5_MATCH(N)')  :(CLAWS5_MATCH_END)
CLAWS5_MATCH  ZI = 1
ZBL     src ? claws  :F(ZBAD)
        ZI = LT(ZI, N) ZI + 1  :S(ZBL)
        CLAWS5_MATCH = 'matched bytes=' SIZE(src)  :(RETURN)
ZBAD    CLAWS5_MATCH = 'Pattern match failed'  :(RETURN)
CLAWS5_MATCH_END
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
        src = INPUT
*BENCH kernel=CLAWS5_MATCH check=1 bud=1000 flr=20
        OUTPUT = CLAWS5_MATCH(1)
END
```

```stdout
matched bytes=0
```

## demo_calculator-1

```SNOBOL4
        DEFINE('EMIT()')
        DEFINE('PSH()')
        DEFINE('DRF(nm)')
        DEFINE('ADD()')
        DEFINE('SUB()')
        DEFINE('MUL()')
        DEFINE('DIV()')
        DEFINE('NEG()')                         :(FNS_end)
EMIT    OUTPUT = DRF(S[1])
        sp = 0
        EMIT = .dm                              :(NRETURN)

PSH     PSH = .S[sp = sp + 1]                   :(NRETURN)
DRF     DRF = nm
        nm ? POS(0) ANY(&LCASE) RPOS(0)         :F(RETURN)
        DRF = vars[nm]                          :(RETURN)
ADD     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) + DRF(S[sp + 1])
        ADD = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
SUB     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) - DRF(S[sp + 1])
        SUB = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
MUL     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) * DRF(S[sp + 1])
        MUL = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
DIV     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) / DRF(S[sp + 1])
        DIV = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
NEG     S[sp] = -DRF(S[sp])
        NEG = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
FNS_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        S = ARRAY(65536)
        V = ANY(&LCASE) . *PSH()
        I = SPAN('0123456789') . *PSH()
        A = V | I | FENCE('(' *X ')')
        F = A | FENCE('+' *F) | FENCE('-' *F . *NEG())
        T = F ( FENCE('*' *T . *MUL()) | FENCE('/' *T . *DIV()) | '' )
        X = T ( FENCE('+' *X . *ADD()) | FENCE('-' *X . *SUB()) | '' )
        eol = CHAR(10) FENCE
        C = POS(0) ARBNO(X eol . *EMIT()) RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        &TRIM = 0
        vars = TABLE()
        vars['x'] = 1
        vars['y'] = 2
        vars['z'] = 3
* read all at once: raw fd 0, one 4 MiB-max transfer (larger inputs truncate)
        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
        src = INPUT
* TIME() is integer nanoseconds off a monotonic wall clock (FINDING s249);
* divide by 1000000 for match_ms, same idiom as harness.inc's "ms:" line.
        t0 = TIME()
        src C                                   :F(bad)
        t1 = TIME()
        TERMINAL = 'match_ms=' (t1 - t0) / 1000000        :(END)
bad     t1 = TIME()
        OUTPUT = 'Boo!'
        TERMINAL = 'match_ms=' (t1 - t0) / 1000000
END
```

## demo_calculator-2

```SNOBOL4
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* calculator-2.sno — precedence calculator, Variant 2: LEFT associativity
* (Lon, 2026-07-24).  Same atoms/factors as calculator-1; terms and
* expressions fold LEFT: 10-2-3 = (10-2)-3 = 5; 8/4/2 = (8/4)/2 = 1.
* Lon's intended form was Gimpel's left-recursive grammar (p. 411, the
* L_ONE program):  T = F | *T ANY('*/') F ;  X = T | *X ANY('+-') T.
* That form worked in mainframe SNOBOL4 ONLY because quickscan assumed
* every deferred pattern eats >= 1 character, bounding the recursion by
* subject length.  Measured 2026-07-24: it stack-overflows on 3+4 under
* SPITBOL (ERROR 246), SCRIP m3 (SEGV, same plunge), and csnobol4 in BOTH
* &FULLSCAN modes (Error 16) — csnobol4's quickscan does not propagate the
* length budget into deferred expansions.  See programs/gimpel/L_ONE.sno's
* header: the Catspaw patch removed the left recursion for SPITBOL and
* bought right associativity as the price; calculator-1.sno is that shape.
* THIS file keeps the associativity left recursion was for, fullscan-safe,
* by ITERATION: T = F ARBNO(op F . *action) — instances match left to
* right, actions fold left.  Unary signs: ANY('+-') pushes the sign char,
* SGN pops value+sign after the recursive *F (sign chains work: --3 = 3).
* Operand order conventional (head OP tail).  Variables in a TABLE keyed
* by letter; x=1, y=2, z=3; other lowercase letters deref to null = 0.
* Shares calculator.input / calculator-gen.py with calculator-1; own ref
* (490 of 2208 lines differ from calculator-1.ref — the associativity
* delta).  Every '/' divisor is a trailing nonzero literal digit, safe
* under either grouping.
* Run: sbl -b calculator-2.sno < calculator.input
*      scrip --run calculator-2.sno < calculator.input
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DEFINE('EMIT()')
        DEFINE('PSH()')
        DEFINE('DRF(nm)')
        DEFINE('ADD()')
        DEFINE('SUB()')
        DEFINE('MUL()')
        DEFINE('DIV()')
        DEFINE('SGN()p1')                       :(FNS_end)
EMIT    OUTPUT = DRF(S[1])
        sp = 0
        EMIT = .dm                              :(NRETURN)
PSH     PSH = .S[sp = sp + 1]                   :(NRETURN)
DRF     DRF = nm
        nm POS(0) ANY(&LCASE) RPOS(0)           :F(RETURN)
        DRF = vars[nm]                          :(RETURN)
ADD     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) + DRF(S[sp + 1])
        ADD = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
SUB     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) - DRF(S[sp + 1])
        SUB = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
MUL     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) * DRF(S[sp + 1])
        MUL = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
DIV     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) / DRF(S[sp + 1])
        DIV = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
SGN     p1 = DRF(S[sp])
        p1 = IDENT(S[sp = sp - 1], '-') -p1
        S[sp] = p1
        SGN = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
FNS_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        S = ARRAY(65536)
        LCASE = &LCASE
        DIGITS = '0123456789'
        V = ANY(&LCASE) . *PSH()
        I = SPAN('0123456789') . *PSH()
        A = FENCE(V | I | '(' *X ')')
        F = FENCE(A | ANY('+-') . *PSH() *F . *SGN())
        T = F ARBNO('*' F . *MUL() | '/' F . *DIV())
        X = T ARBNO('+' T . *ADD() | '-' T . *SUB())
        eol = CHAR(10) FENCE
        C = POS(0) ARBNO(X eol (epsilon . *EMIT())) RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        &TRIM = 0
        vars = TABLE()
        vars['x'] = 1
        vars['y'] = 2
        vars['z'] = 3
* read all at once: raw fd 0, one 4 MiB-max transfer (larger inputs truncate)
        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
        src = INPUT
* TIME() is integer nanoseconds off a monotonic wall clock (FINDING s249);
* divide by 1000000 for match_ms, same idiom as harness.inc's "ms:" line.
        t0 = TIME()
        src C                                   :F(bad)
        t1 = TIME()
        TERMINAL = 'match_ms=' (t1 - t0) / 1000000        :(END)
bad     t1 = TIME()
        OUTPUT = 'Boo!'
        TERMINAL = 'match_ms=' (t1 - t0) / 1000000
END
```

## benchmark_porter

```SNOBOL4
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// porter.sno — Porter (1980) stemming algorithm in SNOBOL4
*//
*// Faithful translation of the Python PATTERN version from CSCE-5200 Project 1, which uses the
*// snobol4python library (SNOBOL4python 0.5.2).  The snobol4python-to-SPITBOL primitive map is:
*//
*//   Python (snobol4python)       SNOBOL4 (SPITBOL)
*//   ──────────────────────       ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
*//   POS(0) / RPOS(0)             POS(0) / RPOS(0)
*//   RTAB(n)                      RTAB(n)
*//   σ('sses')                    'sses'
*//   P @ "var"                    P $ var          (immediate — at match time; used for guards)
*//   P % "var"                    P . var          (conditional — on commit; used to keep text)
*//   Λ(callable)                  *pred_fn()       (pattern-valued fn: '' = ok, FAIL = nope)
*//   λ("stmt")                    (epsilon . *action_fn())   (deferred commit-time side effect)
*//   A | B                        A | B
*//   A + B                        A B              (juxtaposition = concatenation)
*//
*// Oracle: SPITBOL x64 (/home/claude/x64/bin/sbl).  Test fixture: voc.txt / output.txt from
*// tartarus.org/martin/PorterStemmer (23,531 words).
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

               &ANCHOR        =  0
               &FULLSCAN      =  1
               epsilon        =

               VOWELS         =  'aeiou'
               LC             =  'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// cons(i): true if stem[i] is a consonant.  Letters 1-indexed (SNOBOL4 SUBSTR is 1-based).
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('cons(i)c')                                   :(cons_end)
cons           c              =  SUBSTR(stem, i, 1)
               c              ANY(VOWELS)                          :S(FRETURN)
               DIFFER(c, 'y')                                       :S(RETURN)
               EQ(i, 1)                                             :S(RETURN)
               cons(i - 1)                                          :S(FRETURN)F(RETURN)
cons_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// m(): Porter's measure — the number of VC sequences in 'stem'.  Returns integer.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('m()i,n,L')                                   :(m_end)
m              L              =  SIZE(stem)
               EQ(L, 0)                                             :S(RETURN)
               i              =  1
               n              =  0
mC0            GT(i, L)                                             :S(RETURN)
               cons(i)                                              :F(mV1)
               i              =  i + 1                              :(mC0)
mV1            i              =  i + 1
mV             GT(i, L)                                             :S(RETURN)
               cons(i)                                              :S(mC1)
               i              =  i + 1                              :(mV)
mC1            i              =  i + 1
               n              =  n + 1
               m              =  n
mC             GT(i, L)                                             :S(RETURN)
               cons(i)                                              :F(mV1)
               i              =  i + 1                              :(mC)
m_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// vowelinstem(): true if any char of stem is a vowel (y after consonant counts).
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('vowelinstem()i,L')                           :(vis_end)
vowelinstem    L              =  SIZE(stem)
               i              =  1
visL           GT(i, L)                                             :S(FRETURN)
               cons(i)                                              :F(RETURN)
               i              =  i + 1                              :(visL)
vis_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// doublec(j): stem[j] == stem[j-1] and both consonants.  j 1-based.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('doublec(j)')                                 :(dc_end)
doublec        LT(j, 2)                                             :S(FRETURN)
               DIFFER(SUBSTR(stem, j, 1), SUBSTR(stem, j - 1, 1))   :S(FRETURN)
               cons(j)                                              :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
dc_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// cvc(i): stem[i-2..i] = c-v-c  and  stem[i] not in {w,x,y}.  i 1-based.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('cvc(i)c')                                    :(cvc_end)
cvc            LT(i, 3)                                             :S(FRETURN)
               cons(i)                                              :F(FRETURN)
               cons(i - 1)                                          :S(FRETURN)
               cons(i - 2)                                          :F(FRETURN)
               c              =  SUBSTR(stem, i, 1)
               c              ANY('wxy')                           :S(FRETURN)F(RETURN)
cvc_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// Guards — pattern-valued.  Return null pattern ('') on success, FAIL on failure.
*// Called as *gX() inside a pattern.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('g_vis()')                                    :(g_vis_end)
g_vis          vowelinstem()                                        :F(gv_no)
               g_vis          =                                     :(RETURN)
gv_no          g_vis          =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_vis_end

               DEFINE('g_m_gt_0()')                                 :(g_m0_end)
g_m_gt_0       GT(m(), 0)                                           :F(gm0_no)
               g_m_gt_0       =                                     :(RETURN)
gm0_no         g_m_gt_0       =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_m0_end

               DEFINE('g_m_gt_1()')                                 :(g_m1_end)
g_m_gt_1       GT(m(), 1)                                           :F(gm1_no)
               g_m_gt_1       =                                     :(RETURN)
gm1_no         g_m_gt_1       =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_m1_end

               DEFINE('g_m_eq_1()')                                 :(g_me1_end)
g_m_eq_1       EQ(m(), 1)                                           :F(gme1_no)
               g_m_eq_1       =                                     :(RETURN)
gme1_no        g_m_eq_1       =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_me1_end

               DEFINE('g_not_cvc_last()L')                          :(g_ncvc_end)
g_not_cvc_last L              =  SIZE(stem)
               cvc(L)                                               :S(gnc_no)
               g_not_cvc_last =                                     :(RETURN)
gnc_no         g_not_cvc_last =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_ncvc_end

               DEFINE('g_stem_not_m()L')                            :(g_snm_end)
g_stem_not_m   L              =  SIZE(stem)
               DIFFER(SUBSTR(stem, L, 1), 'm')                      :F(gsnm_no)
               g_stem_not_m   =                                     :(RETURN)
gsnm_no        g_stem_not_m   =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_snm_end

               DEFINE('g_stem_last_st()L,last')                     :(g_sls_end)
g_stem_last_st L              =  SIZE(stem)
               last           =  SUBSTR(stem, L, 1)
               last           ANY('st')                            :F(gsls_no)
               g_stem_last_st =                                     :(RETURN)
gsls_no        g_stem_last_st =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_sls_end

               DEFINE('g_m_ll_gt_1()save,r')                        :(g_mll_end)
g_m_ll_gt_1    save           =  stem
               stem           =  save 'll'
               r              =  m()
               stem           =  save
               GT(r, 1)                                             :F(gmll_no)
               g_m_ll_gt_1    =                                     :(RETURN)
gmll_no        g_m_ll_gt_1    =  FAIL                               :(RETURN)
g_mll_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// Action setters.  Each corresponds to λ("target='X'") in the Python.  Called via
*// (epsilon . *s_X()) so they fire at commit time on the winning arm.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('s_ss()')    :(s_ss_end)
s_ss           target         =  'ss'
               s_ss           =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ss_end
               DEFINE('s_i()')     :(s_i_end)
s_i            target         =  'i'
               s_i            =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_i_end
               DEFINE('s_empty()') :(s_empty_end)
s_empty        target         =
               s_empty        =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_empty_end
               DEFINE('s_ee()')    :(s_ee_end)
s_ee           target         =  'ee'
               s_ee           =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ee_end
               DEFINE('s_ate()')   :(s_ate_end)
s_ate          target         =  'ate'
               s_ate          =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ate_end
               DEFINE('s_tion()')  :(s_tion_end)
s_tion         target         =  'tion'
               s_tion         =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_tion_end
               DEFINE('s_ence()')  :(s_ence_end)
s_ence         target         =  'ence'
               s_ence         =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ence_end
               DEFINE('s_ance()')  :(s_ance_end)
s_ance         target         =  'ance'
               s_ance         =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ance_end
               DEFINE('s_ize()')   :(s_ize_end)
s_ize          target         =  'ize'
               s_ize          =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ize_end
               DEFINE('s_ble()')   :(s_ble_end)
s_ble          target         =  'ble'
               s_ble          =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ble_end
               DEFINE('s_al()')    :(s_al_end)
s_al           target         =  'al'
               s_al           =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_al_end
               DEFINE('s_ent()')   :(s_ent_end)
s_ent          target         =  'ent'
               s_ent          =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ent_end
               DEFINE('s_e()')     :(s_e_end)
s_e            target         =  'e'
               s_e            =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_e_end
               DEFINE('s_ous()')   :(s_ous_end)
s_ous          target         =  'ous'
               s_ous          =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ous_end
               DEFINE('s_ive()')   :(s_ive_end)
s_ive          target         =  'ive'
               s_ive          =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ive_end
               DEFINE('s_ful()')   :(s_ful_end)
s_ful          target         =  'ful'
               s_ful          =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ful_end
               DEFINE('s_log()')   :(s_log_end)
s_log          target         =  'log'
               s_log          =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_log_end
               DEFINE('s_ic()')    :(s_ic_end)
s_ic           target         =  'ic'
               s_ic           =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_ic_end
               DEFINE('s_l()')     :(s_l_end)
s_l            target         =  'l'
               s_l            =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
s_l_end

*// step1ab_cleanup — Python's λ("porter_step1ab_cleanup()"): commit-time action (NOT a guard)
*// that sets target and may mutate stem.
               DEFINE('a_s1ab_cleanup()L,last,P')                   :(a_s1ab_end)
a_s1ab_cleanup
               L              =  SIZE(stem)
               P              =  RTAB(2) ('at' | 'bl' | 'iz') RPOS(0)
               stem           P                                     :F(a_s1_next1)
               target         =  'e'                                :(a_s1_done)
a_s1_next1     doublec(L)                                           :F(a_s1_next2)
               last           =  SUBSTR(stem, L, 1)
               last           ANY('lsz')                           :S(a_s1_next2)
               stem           =  SUBSTR(stem, 1, L - 1)
               target         =                                     :(a_s1_done)
a_s1_next2     EQ(m(), 1)                                           :F(a_s1_else)
               cvc(L)                                               :F(a_s1_else)
               target         =  'e'                                :(a_s1_done)
a_s1_else      target         =
a_s1_done      a_s1ab_cleanup =  .dummy                             :(NRETURN)
a_s1ab_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// Porter rule patterns.  Read these top-down next to the Python source — they are the same shape.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               p1a            =
+              POS(0)
+              ( RTAB(4) $ stem 'sses' (epsilon . *s_ss())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ies'  (epsilon . *s_i())
+              | RTAB(2) $ stem 'ss'   (epsilon . *s_ss())
+              | RTAB(1) $ stem 's'    (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              )
+              RPOS(0)

               p1b            =
+              POS(0)
+              ( RTAB(3) $ stem 'eed' (*g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ee()) | epsilon)
+              | RTAB(2) $ stem 'ed'  *g_vis() (epsilon . *a_s1ab_cleanup())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ing' *g_vis() (epsilon . *a_s1ab_cleanup())
+              )
+              RPOS(0)

               p1c            =
+              POS(0)
+              ( RTAB(1) $ stem 'y' *g_vis() (epsilon . *s_i())
+              )
+              RPOS(0)

               p2             =
+              POS(0)
+              ( RTAB(7) $ stem 'ational' *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ate())
+              | RTAB(6) $ stem 'tional'  *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_tion())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'enci'    *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ence())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'anci'    *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ance())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'izer'    *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ize())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'bli'     *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ble())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'alli'    *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_al())
+              | RTAB(5) $ stem 'entli'   *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ent())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'eli'     *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_e())
+              | RTAB(5) $ stem 'ousli'   *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ous())
+              | RTAB(7) $ stem 'ization' *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ize())
+              | RTAB(5) $ stem 'ation'   *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ate())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'ator'    *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ate())
+              | RTAB(5) $ stem 'alism'   *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_al())
+              | RTAB(7) $ stem 'iveness' *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ive())
+              | RTAB(7) $ stem 'fulness' *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ful())
+              | RTAB(7) $ stem 'ousness' *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ous())
+              | RTAB(5) $ stem 'aliti'   *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_al())
+              | RTAB(5) $ stem 'iviti'   *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ive())
+              | RTAB(6) $ stem 'biliti'  *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ble())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'logi'    *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_log())
+              )
+              RPOS(0)

               p3             =
+              POS(0)
+              ( RTAB(5) $ stem 'icate' *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ic())
+              | RTAB(5) $ stem 'ative' *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(5) $ stem 'alize' *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_al())
+              | RTAB(5) $ stem 'iciti' *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ic())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'ical'  *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_ic())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ful'   *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'ness'  *g_m_gt_0() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              )
+              RPOS(0)

               p4             =
+              POS(0)
+              ( RTAB(2) $ stem 'al'    *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'ance'  *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'ence'  *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(2) $ stem 'er'    *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(2) $ stem 'ic'    *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'able'  *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'ible'  *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ant'   *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(5) $ stem 'ement' *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(4) $ stem 'ment'  *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ent'   *g_m_gt_1() *g_stem_not_m() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ion'   *g_m_gt_1() *g_stem_last_st() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(2) $ stem 'ou'    *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ism'   *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ate'   *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'iti'   *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ous'   *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ive'   *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              | RTAB(3) $ stem 'ize'   *g_m_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              )
+              RPOS(0)

               p5a            =
+              POS(0)
+              ( RTAB(1) $ stem 'e'
+                ( *g_m_gt_1()
+                | *g_m_eq_1() *g_not_cvc_last()
+                )
+                (epsilon . *s_empty())
+              )
+              RPOS(0)

+              POS(0)
+              ( RTAB(2) $ stem 'll' *g_m_ll_gt_1() (epsilon . *s_l())
+              )
+              RPOS(0)

*// stemmer(token): run the Porter pipeline.  Sentinel 'UNSET' on target detects non-firing pattern.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('stemmer(token)')                             :(stm_end)
stemmer        LE(SIZE(token), 2)                                   :F(stm_run)
               stemmer        =  token                              :(RETURN)
stm_run        token          =  REPLACE(token, &UCASE, LC)

               target         =  'UNSET'
               token          p1a                                   :F(stm_1b)
               DIFFER(target, 'UNSET')                              :F(stm_1b)
               token          =  stem target

stm_1b         target         =  'UNSET'
               token          p1b                                   :F(stm_1c)
               DIFFER(target, 'UNSET')                              :F(stm_1c)
               token          =  stem target

stm_1c         target         =  'UNSET'
               token          p1c                                   :F(stm_2)
               DIFFER(target, 'UNSET')                              :F(stm_2)
               token          =  stem target

stm_2          target         =  'UNSET'
               token          p2                                    :F(stm_3)
               DIFFER(target, 'UNSET')                              :F(stm_3)
               token          =  stem target

stm_3          target         =  'UNSET'
               token          p3                                    :F(stm_4)
               DIFFER(target, 'UNSET')                              :F(stm_4)
               token          =  stem target

stm_4          target         =  'UNSET'
               token          p4                                    :F(stm_5a)
               DIFFER(target, 'UNSET')                              :F(stm_5a)
               token          =  stem target

stm_5a         target         =  'UNSET'
               token          p5a                                   :F(stm_5b)
               DIFFER(target, 'UNSET')                              :F(stm_5b)
               token          =  stem target

stm_5b         target         =  'UNSET'
               token          p5b                                   :F(stm_done)
               DIFFER(target, 'UNSET')                              :F(stm_done)
               token          =  stem target

stm_done       stemmer        =  token                              :(RETURN)
stm_end

*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*// Driver: slurp every input word, then write each word's stem to OUTPUT.
*// PORTER(N) re-stems the whole word list N times and returns the total stem length;
*// it is what scripts/bench_wrap.sh times.  The standalone driver below IS the stemmer.
*// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               WORDS          =  ARRAY(32768)
               NW             =  0
PLOAD          PLINE          =  INPUT                              :F(PLOADED)
               NW             =  NW + 1
               WORDS[NW]      =  PLINE                              :(PLOAD)
PLOADED        EQ(NW, 0)                                            :S(END)
               DEFINE('PORTER(N)')                                  :(PORTER_END)
PORTER         ZI             =  1
ZBL            ZACC           =  0
               ZJ             =  1
ZWLP           ZACC           =  ZACC + SIZE(stemmer(WORDS[ZJ]))
               ZJ             =  LT(ZJ, NW) ZJ + 1                  :S(ZWLP)
               ZI             =  LT(ZI, N) ZI + 1                   :S(ZBL)
               PORTER         =  ZACC                               :(RETURN)
PORTER_END
*BENCH kernel=PORTER check=1 bud=1000 flr=20
               PJ             =  1
PNEXT          OUTPUT         =  stemmer(WORDS[PJ])
               PJ             =  LT(PJ, NW) PJ + 1                  :S(PNEXT)
END
```

## benchmark_treebank-match-fence

```SNOBOL4
        &TRIM       =   0
        delim       =   SPAN(' ' CHAR(10))
        word        =   NOTANY('( )' CHAR(10))
+                       BREAK('( )' CHAR(10))
        group       =   '('
+                       word
+                       ARBNO(delim FENCE(*group | word))
+                       ')'
        treebank    =   POS(0) ARBNO(ARBNO(*group FENCE) delim FENCE) RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* TREEBANK_MATCH_FENCE(N) -- run the recognizer N times over the slurped source and report the
* number of bytes it matched.  N=1 is what the standalone driver below asks for;
* the timed twin built by scripts/bench_wrap.sh asks for many.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DEFINE('TREEBANK_MATCH_FENCE(N)')  :(TREEBANK_MATCH_FENCE_END)
TREEBANK_MATCH_FENCE  ZI = 1
ZBL     src ? treebank  :F(ZBAD)
        ZI = LT(ZI, N) ZI + 1  :S(ZBL)
        TREEBANK_MATCH_FENCE = 'matched bytes=' SIZE(src)  :(RETURN)
ZBAD    TREEBANK_MATCH_FENCE = 'Pattern match failed'  :(RETURN)
TREEBANK_MATCH_FENCE_END
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

## benchmark_json-match-fence

```SNOBOL4
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                &TRIM          =  0
                $' '           =  FENCE(SPAN(' ' CHAR(9) CHAR(10) CHAR(13)) | '')
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                jescape        =  '\'
+                                 ( ANY('"/bfnrt\')
+                                 | 'u'
+                                   ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF')
+                                   ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF')
+                                   ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF')
+                                   ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF')
+                                 )
                jchunk         =  BREAK('"\' CHAR(10) CHAR(13))
                jstring        =  '"' jchunk ARBNO(jescape jchunk) '"' FENCE
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                jnumber        =  FENCE('-' | '')
+                                 ('0' | ANY('123456789') FENCE(SPAN('0123456789') | ''))
+                                 FENCE('.' SPAN('0123456789') | '')
+                                 FENCE( ANY('eE') FENCE(ANY('+-') | '') SPAN('0123456789')
+                                      | ''
+                                      )
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                jmember        =  $' ' jstring $' ' ':' *jelement
                jobject        =  '{' ( jmember ARBNO($' ' ',' jmember) | $' ' ) '}'
                jarray         =  '[' ( *jelement ARBNO($' ' ',' *jelement) | $' ' ) ']'
                jvalue         =  ( jstring
+                                 | jnumber
+                                 | jobject FENCE
+                                 | jarray FENCE
+                                 | 'true'
+                                 | 'false'
+                                 | 'null'
+                                 )
                jelement       =  $' ' *jvalue $' '
                json           =  POS(0) jelement RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* JSON_MATCH_FENCE(N) -- run the recognizer N times over the slurped source and report the
* number of bytes it matched.  N=1 is what the standalone driver below asks for;
* the timed twin built by scripts/bench_wrap.sh asks for many.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DEFINE('JSON_MATCH_FENCE(N)')  :(JSON_MATCH_FENCE_END)
JSON_MATCH_FENCE  ZI = 1
ZBL     src json  :F(ZBAD)
        ZI = LT(ZI, N) ZI + 1  :S(ZBL)
        JSON_MATCH_FENCE = 'matched bytes=' SIZE(src)  :(RETURN)
ZBAD    JSON_MATCH_FENCE = 'Pattern match failed'  :(RETURN)
JSON_MATCH_FENCE_END
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
        src = INPUT
*BENCH kernel=JSON_MATCH_FENCE check=1 bud=1000 flr=20
        OUTPUT = JSON_MATCH_FENCE(1)
END
```

## benchmark_calculator-1

```SNOBOL4
        DEFINE('EMIT()')
        DEFINE('PSH()')
        DEFINE('DRF(nm)')
        DEFINE('ADD()')
        DEFINE('SUB()')
        DEFINE('MUL()')
        DEFINE('DIV()')
        DEFINE('NEG()')                         :(FNS_end)
EMIT    OUTPUT = EQ(quiet) DRF(S[1])
        sp = 0
        EMIT = .dm                              :(NRETURN)

PSH     PSH = .S[sp = sp + 1]                   :(NRETURN)
DRF     DRF = nm
        nm ? POS(0) ANY(&LCASE) RPOS(0)         :F(RETURN)
        DRF = vars[nm]                          :(RETURN)
ADD     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) + DRF(S[sp + 1])
        ADD = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
SUB     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) - DRF(S[sp + 1])
        SUB = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
MUL     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) * DRF(S[sp + 1])
        MUL = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
DIV     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) / DRF(S[sp + 1])
        DIV = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
NEG     S[sp] = -DRF(S[sp])
        NEG = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
FNS_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        S = ARRAY(65536)
        V = ANY(&LCASE) . *PSH()
        I = SPAN('0123456789') . *PSH()
        A = V | I | FENCE('(' *X ')')
        F = A | FENCE('+' *F) | FENCE('-' *F . *NEG())
        T = F ( FENCE('*' *T . *MUL()) | FENCE('/' *T . *DIV()) | '' )
        X = T ( FENCE('+' *X . *ADD()) | FENCE('-' *X . *SUB()) | '' )
        eol = CHAR(10) FENCE
        C = POS(0) ARBNO(X eol . *EMIT()) RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        &TRIM = 0
        vars = TABLE()
        vars['x'] = 1
        vars['y'] = 2
        vars['z'] = 3
* read all at once: raw fd 0, one 4 MiB-max transfer (larger inputs truncate)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* quiet -- 0 prints every evaluated line (the application's real answer), 1 keeps
* the arithmetic and suppresses the printing.  CALCULATOR_1(N) below re-evaluates
* the whole input N times with printing off; the standalone driver at the bottom
* leaves it on and IS the calculator.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        quiet = 0
        DEFINE('CALCULATOR_1(N)')  :(CALCULATOR_1_END)
CALCULATOR_1  quiet = 1
        ZI = 1
ZBL     sp = 0
        src C  :F(ZBAD)
        ZI = LT(ZI, N) ZI + 1  :S(ZBL)
        quiet = 0
        CALCULATOR_1 = 'matched bytes=' SIZE(src)  :(RETURN)
ZBAD    quiet = 0
        CALCULATOR_1 = 'Pattern match failed'  :(RETURN)
CALCULATOR_1_END
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
        src = INPUT
*BENCH kernel=CALCULATOR_1 check=1 bud=1000 flr=20
* TIME() is integer nanoseconds off a monotonic wall clock (FINDING s249);
* divide by 1000000 for match_ms.  TERMINAL is stderr, so stdout stays byte-comparable.
        t0 = TIME()
        sp = 0
        src C                                   :F(bad)
        t1 = TIME()
        TERMINAL = 'match_ms=' (t1 - t0) / 1000000        :(END)
bad     t1 = TIME()
        OUTPUT = 'Boo!'
        TERMINAL = 'match_ms=' (t1 - t0) / 1000000
END
```

## demo_treebank-alloc

```SNOBOL4
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* treebank-alloc.sno -- the ALLOCATING twin of treebank-match.sno.
* Same grammar, same tape, same input: the ONLY difference is that this one runs
* ACTION ROUTINES that ALLOCATE (one ARRAY per node, retained in a TABLE) while
* the match runs, so the GC share of a matching workload becomes measurable.
* The actions ride the NON-CAPTURE deferred call *fn() with immediate ($) capture
* -- manual v3.7 p.87 'Immediate assignment and deferred evaluation' -- because a
* non-capture call is NOT retracted when an alternative is abandoned: every path
* the matcher tries allocates, which is the point of a GC workload.
* It is therefore NOT the treebank PARSE.  The faithful parser is the manual's
* Ch.9 p.136 action-routine ploy (conditional assignment, treebank.sno), which
* SCRIP cannot run correctly today; see the s193 FINDING.
* The identity gate is the ALLOCATION-SEQUENCE CHECKSUM, not 'matched bytes':
* nodes/words/pops/ck pin the exact number and order of allocations, and a run
* that matches while allocating nothing cannot pass it.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('init_bank(v)')
                DEFINE('push_tag(v)')
                DEFINE('push_word(v)')
                DEFINE('pop_tag()')
                DEFINE('fin_bank(v)')                                   :(ActEnd)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
init_bank       $v              =
                tags            =   TABLE()
                live            =   TABLE()
                depth           =   0
                nlist           =   0;  nitem = 0;  npop = 0;  ck = 0
                init_bank       =                                       :(RETURN)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
push_tag        nlist           =   nlist + 1
                depth           =   depth + 1
                tags[v]         =   tags[v] + 1
                node            =   ARRAY('0:2')
                node[0]         =   v
                node[1]         =   depth
                node[2]         =   nlist
                live[nlist]     =   node
                ck              =   ck + depth + SIZE(v)
                push_tag        =                                       :(RETURN)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
push_word       nitem           =   nitem + 1
                node            =   ARRAY('0:2')
                node[0]         =   v
                node[1]         =   depth
                node[2]         =   nitem
                ck              =   ck + depth + SIZE(v) + 1
                push_word       =                                       :(RETURN)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
pop_tag         npop            =   npop + 1
                depth           =   depth - 1
                ck              =   ck + depth
                pop_tag         =                                       :(RETURN)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
fin_bank        $v              =   ck
                fin_bank        =                                       :(RETURN)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ActEnd
StackEnd        delim           =   SPAN(' ' CHAR(10))
                word            =   NOTANY('( )' CHAR(10)) BREAK('( )' CHAR(10))
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                group           =   '('
+                                   word $ tag *push_tag(tag)
+                                   ARBNO(
+                                     delim
+                                     FENCE(
+                                       *group
+                                     | word $ wrd *push_word(wrd)
+                                     )
+                                   )
+                                   *pop_tag()
+                                   ')'
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                treebank        =   POS(0)
+                                   *init_bank('bank')
+                                   *push_tag('BANK')
+                                   ARBNO(
+                                     *push_tag('ROOT')
+                                     ARBNO(*group FENCE)
+                                     delim
+                                     FENCE
+                                     *pop_tag()
+                                   )
+                                   *fin_bank('bank')
+                                   RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r1000000]')
                src             =   INPUT  :F(error)
                src             ?   treebank  :F(error)
                OUTPUT          =   'matched bytes=' SIZE(src)
                OUTPUT          =   'nodes=' nlist ' words=' nitem ' pops=' npop ' ck=' ck ' bank=' bank  :(END)
error           OUTPUT          =   'Pattern match failed'
END
```

## benchmark_calculator-2

```SNOBOL4
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* calculator-2.sno — precedence calculator, Variant 2: LEFT associativity
* (Lon, 2026-07-24).  Same atoms/factors as calculator-1; terms and
* expressions fold LEFT: 10-2-3 = (10-2)-3 = 5; 8/4/2 = (8/4)/2 = 1.
* Lon's intended form was Gimpel's left-recursive grammar (p. 411, the
* L_ONE program):  T = F | *T ANY('*/') F ;  X = T | *X ANY('+-') T.
* That form worked in mainframe SNOBOL4 ONLY because quickscan assumed
* every deferred pattern eats >= 1 character, bounding the recursion by
* subject length.  Measured 2026-07-24: it stack-overflows on 3+4 under
* SPITBOL (ERROR 246), SCRIP m3 (SEGV, same plunge), and csnobol4 in BOTH
* &FULLSCAN modes (Error 16) — csnobol4's quickscan does not propagate the
* length budget into deferred expansions.  See programs/gimpel/L_ONE.sno's
* header: the Catspaw patch removed the left recursion for SPITBOL and
* bought right associativity as the price; calculator-1.sno is that shape.
* THIS file keeps the associativity left recursion was for, fullscan-safe,
* by ITERATION: T = F ARBNO(op F . *action) — instances match left to
* right, actions fold left.  Unary signs: ANY('+-') pushes the sign char,
* SGN pops value+sign after the recursive *F (sign chains work: --3 = 3).
* Operand order conventional (head OP tail).  Variables in a TABLE keyed
* by letter; x=1, y=2, z=3; other lowercase letters deref to null = 0.
* Shares calculator.input / calculator-gen.py with calculator-1; own ref
* (490 of 2208 lines differ from calculator-1.ref — the associativity
* delta).  Every '/' divisor is a trailing nonzero literal digit, safe
* under either grouping.
* Run: sbl -b calculator-2.sno < calculator.input
*      scrip --run calculator-2.sno < calculator.input
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DEFINE('EMIT()')
        DEFINE('PSH()')
        DEFINE('DRF(nm)')
        DEFINE('ADD()')
        DEFINE('SUB()')
        DEFINE('MUL()')
        DEFINE('DIV()')
        DEFINE('SGN()p1')                       :(FNS_end)
EMIT    OUTPUT = EQ(quiet) DRF(S[1])
        sp = 0
        EMIT = .dm                              :(NRETURN)
PSH     PSH = .S[sp = sp + 1]                   :(NRETURN)
DRF     DRF = nm
        nm POS(0) ANY(&LCASE) RPOS(0)           :F(RETURN)
        DRF = vars[nm]                          :(RETURN)
ADD     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) + DRF(S[sp + 1])
        ADD = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
SUB     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) - DRF(S[sp + 1])
        SUB = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
MUL     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) * DRF(S[sp + 1])
        MUL = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
DIV     S[sp = sp - 1] = DRF(S[sp]) / DRF(S[sp + 1])
        DIV = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
SGN     p1 = DRF(S[sp])
        p1 = IDENT(S[sp = sp - 1], '-') -p1
        S[sp] = p1
        SGN = .dm                               :(NRETURN)
FNS_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        S = ARRAY(65536)
        LCASE = &LCASE
        DIGITS = '0123456789'
        V = ANY(&LCASE) . *PSH()
        I = SPAN('0123456789') . *PSH()
        A = FENCE(V | I | '(' *X ')')
        F = FENCE(A | ANY('+-') . *PSH() *F . *SGN())
        T = F ARBNO('*' F . *MUL() | '/' F . *DIV())
        X = T ARBNO('+' T . *ADD() | '-' T . *SUB())
        eol = CHAR(10) FENCE
        C = POS(0) ARBNO(X eol (epsilon . *EMIT())) RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        &TRIM = 0
        vars = TABLE()
        vars['x'] = 1
        vars['y'] = 2
        vars['z'] = 3
* read all at once: raw fd 0, one 4 MiB-max transfer (larger inputs truncate)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* quiet -- 0 prints every evaluated line (the application's real answer), 1 keeps
* the arithmetic and suppresses the printing.  CALCULATOR_2(N) below re-evaluates
* the whole input N times with printing off; the standalone driver at the bottom
* leaves it on and IS the calculator.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        quiet = 0
        DEFINE('CALCULATOR_2(N)')  :(CALCULATOR_2_END)
CALCULATOR_2  quiet = 1
        ZI = 1
ZBL     sp = 0
        src C  :F(ZBAD)
        ZI = LT(ZI, N) ZI + 1  :S(ZBL)
        quiet = 0
        CALCULATOR_2 = 'matched bytes=' SIZE(src)  :(RETURN)
ZBAD    quiet = 0
        CALCULATOR_2 = 'Pattern match failed'  :(RETURN)
CALCULATOR_2_END
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
        src = INPUT
*BENCH kernel=CALCULATOR_2 check=1 bud=1000 flr=20
* TIME() is integer nanoseconds off a monotonic wall clock (FINDING s249);
* divide by 1000000 for match_ms.  TERMINAL is stderr, so stdout stays byte-comparable.
        t0 = TIME()
        sp = 0
        src C                                   :F(bad)
        t1 = TIME()
        TERMINAL = 'match_ms=' (t1 - t0) / 1000000        :(END)
bad     t1 = TIME()
        OUTPUT = 'Boo!'
        TERMINAL = 'match_ms=' (t1 - t0) / 1000000
END
```

## user_function_arbno_span_replace_branch_3

```SNOBOL4
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* claws5.sno — CLAWS5 POS-tagged corpus tokenizer
* ENG 685, Lon Cherryholmes Sr.
* Run: sbl -b claws5.sno   (CLAWS5inTASA.dat must be in working directory)
*
* Faithful SNOBOL4 port of assignment3.py (claws_info pattern).
* Function names match Python lambda semantics:
*   init()      λ("mem = dict()")
*   new_sent()  λ("num=int(num)") + λ("mem[num]=dict()")
*   add_tok()   λ("if wrd not in mem[num][wrd]: ...") + λ("mem[num][wrd][tag]+=1")
*
* Each is a single NRETURN function; called as  epsilon . *fn()  in the pattern.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               &TRIM           =  1
               &ANCHOR         =  0
               &FULLSCAN       =  1
               &ALPHABET       POS(10) LEN(1) . nl
               DIGITS          =  '0123456789'
               UCASE           =  'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  init() — λ("mem = dict()")
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('init()')                             :(init_end)
init           mem             =  TABLE()
               sentno          =  0
               init            =  .dummy                    :(NRETURN)
init_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  new_sent() — λ("num=int(num)") + λ("mem[num]=dict()")
*  Reads global: num (captured by SPAN(DIGITS) . num just before)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('new_sent()')                         :(new_sent_end)
new_sent       sentno          =  +num
               mem[sentno]     =  TABLE()
               new_sent        =  .dummy                    :(NRETURN)
new_sent_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  add_tok() — λ("if wrd not in mem[num]:      mem[num][wrd]=dict()")
*            + λ("if tag not in mem[num][wrd]: mem[num][wrd][tag]=0")
*            + λ("mem[num][wrd][tag] += 1")
*  Reads globals: sentno, wrd, tag
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('add_tok()')                          :(add_tok_end)
add_tok        DIFFER(mem[sentno][wrd])                     :F(new_wrd)
               DIFFER(mem[sentno][wrd][tag])                :F(new_tag)
               mem[sentno][wrd][tag]  =  mem[sentno][wrd][tag] + 1  :(done)
new_wrd        mem[sentno][wrd]       =  TABLE()
new_tag        mem[sentno][wrd][tag]  =  1
done           add_tok         =  .dummy                    :(NRETURN)
add_tok_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  claws_pat — direct port of Python claws_info pattern:
*    POS(0)
*    + λ("mem=dict()")
*    + ARBNO(
*        ( SPAN(DIGITS)%"num" + σ('_CRD :_PUN') + λ("num=int(num)") + λ("mem[num]=dict()")
*        | (NOTANY("_")+BREAK("_"))%"wrd" + σ('_')
*          + (ANY(UCASE)+SPAN(DIGITS+UCASE))%"tag"
*          + λ("mem[num][wrd][tag]+=1")
*        ) + σ(' ')
*      )
*    + RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               claws_pat       =
+              POS(0)
+              (epsilon . *init())
+              ARBNO(
+                ( (SPAN(DIGITS) . num) '_CRD :_PUN'
+                  (epsilon . *new_sent())
+                | (NOTANY('_') BREAK('_')) . wrd
+                  '_'
+                  (ANY(UCASE) SPAN(DIGITS UCASE)) . tag
+                  (epsilon . *add_tok())
+                )
+                ' '
+              )
+              RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               DEFINE('pp_mem()sk,wk,tk,si,wi,ti')          :(pp_mem_end)
pp_mem         OUTPUT          =  '{'
               sk              =  SORT(mem)
               si              =  0
pp_s           si              =  si + 1
               sk[si,1]                                     :F(pp_s_done)
               si              GT(si, 1) OUTPUT = '   },'
               OUTPUT          =  '   ' sk[si,1] ': {'
               wk              =  SORT(mem[sk[si,1]])
               wi              =  0
pp_w           wi              =  wi + 1
               wk[wi,1]                                     :F(pp_w_done)
               wi              GT(wi, 1) OUTPUT = '      },'
               OUTPUT          =  '      ' wk[wi,1] ': {'
               tk              =  SORT(mem[sk[si,1]][wk[wi,1]])
               ti              =  0
pp_t           ti              =  ti + 1
               tk[ti,1]                                     :F(pp_t_done)
               OUTPUT          =  '         '
+                                 tk[ti,1] ': '
+                                 mem[sk[si,1]][wk[wi,1]][tk[ti,1]]
+                                 ','                        :(pp_t)
pp_t_done      OUTPUT          =  '      }'                 :(pp_w)
pp_w_done      OUTPUT          =  '   }'                    :(pp_s)
pp_s_done      OUTPUT          =  '}'
               pp_mem          =  .dummy                    :(RETURN)
pp_mem_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               INPUT(.rdch, 8, 'CLAWS5inTASA.dat')          :F(main_err)
slurp          line            =  rdch                      :F(slurp_done)
               src             =  src line ' '              :(slurp)
slurp_done     ENDFILE(8)
               src             ?  claws_pat                 :F(main_fail)
               pp_mem()                                     :(END)
main_fail      OUTPUT          =  'Pattern match failed'    :(END)
main_err       OUTPUT          =  'Could not read CLAWS5inTASA.dat'
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
END
```

```stdout
Could not read CLAWS5inTASA.dat
```

## user_function_arbno_fence_replace_branch_1

```SNOBOL4
*  claws5_table_flat1 -- minimal witness, row table-flat-1level-segv (FINDING-2026-08-21-s199).
*  Flattens claws5's 3-level counts[number][word][tag] table build to ONE level, counts[word],
*  keeping the SAME grammar shape (FENCE/ARBNO + a deferred *token() callout) claws5 itself uses.
*  Self-contained: no -INCLUDE, no file I/O, one deterministic pass over an embedded literal line.
        &TRIM = 0
        DEFINE('token()')  :(token_end)
token   number = +number
        counts = IDENT(counts) TABLE()
        counts[word] = IDENT(counts[word]) 0
        counts[word] = counts[word] + 1
        token = .dummy  :(NRETURN)
token_end
        grammar = POS(0)
+                 ARBNO(
+                   FENCE(
+                     (SPAN('0123456789') . number) '_CRD :_PUN'
+                   | (NOTANY('_') BREAK('_')) . word
+                     '_'
+                     (ANY(&UCASE) SPAN('0123456789' &UCASE)) . tag . *token()
+                   )
+                   SPAN(' ' CHAR(10))
+                 )
+                 RPOS(0)
        text = '1_CRD dog_NN1 cat_NN2 dog_NN1' CHAR(10)
        text ? grammar                                  :F(bad)
        OUTPUT = 'dog=' counts['dog'] ' cat=' counts['cat']  :(done)
bad     OUTPUT = 'MATCH-FAILED'
done
END
```

```stdout
dog=2 cat=1
```

```SNOBOL4
* y1: faithful Stmt skeleton -- real seam/FENCE/epsilon-shift topology, Expr road stubbed to fail
          $('Z' 'Z') = 1
          &FULLSCAN = 1
          &ALPHABET      POS(0)  LEN(1) . nul    ;* null character
          &ALPHABET      POS(8)  LEN(1) . bs     ;* backspace
          &ALPHABET      POS(9)  LEN(1) . ht     ;* horizontal tab
          &ALPHABET      POS(9)  LEN(1) . tab    ;* tab
          &ALPHABET      POS(10) LEN(1) . nl     ;* new line
          &ALPHABET      POS(10) LEN(1) . lf     ;* line feed
          &ALPHABET      POS(11) LEN(1) . vt     ;* vertical tab
          &ALPHABET      POS(12) LEN(1) . ff     ;* form feed
          &ALPHABET      POS(13) LEN(1) . cr     ;* carriage return
          &ALPHABET      POS(47) LEN(1) . fSlash ;* forward slash
          &ALPHABET      POS(59) LEN(1) . semicolon ;* semi-colon
          &ALPHABET      POS(92) LEN(1) . bSlash ;* back slash
          &ALPHABET      POS(0)                      LEN(128) . X0xxxxxxx
          &ALPHABET      POS(128)                    LEN(128) . X1xxxxxxx
          &ALPHABET      POS(128)                    LEN(64)  . X10xxxxxx
          &ALPHABET      POS(128 + 64)               LEN(32)  . X110xxxxx
          &ALPHABET      POS(128 + 64 + 32)          LEN(16)  . X1110xxxx
          &ALPHABET      POS(128 + 64 + 32 + 16)     LEN(8)   . X11110xxx
          &ALPHABET      POS(128 + 64 + 32 + 16 + 8) LEN(8)   . X11111xxx
          nl = CHAR(10)
          tab = CHAR(9)
          DEFINE('SH(t,v)')
          DEFINE('shf9(p,t)')
          DEFINE('PC()')
          DEFINE('nPush()')
          DEFINE('nPop2()')
          DEFINE('RD(t,n)')
          DEFINE('red9(t,n)')
          OPSYN('@', 'red9', 2)                         :(SEND)
SH        OUTPUT = 'SH(' t ',' v ')'
          SH = .dummy                                     :(NRETURN)
shf9      shf9 = EVAL("p . thx . *SH('" t "', thx)")     :(RETURN)
RD        OUTPUT = 'RD(' t ',' n ')'
          RD = .dummy                                     :(NRETURN)
red9      red9 = EVAL("epsilon . *RD(" t ", " n ")")    :(RETURN)
PC        OUTPUT = 'PC()'
          PC = .dummy                                     :(NRETURN)
nPush     nPush = epsilon . *PC()                         :(RETURN)
nPop2     nPop2 = epsilon . *PC()                         :(RETURN)
SEND
          White = ( SPAN(' ' tab)
+                   FENCE(nl ('+' | '.') FENCE(SPAN(' ' tab) | epsilon) | epsilon)
+                 | nl ('+' | '.') FENCE(SPAN(' ' tab) | epsilon)
+                 )
          Gray = *White | epsilon
          Goto2 = *Gray ':' *Gray
          Label = shf9(BREAK(' ' tab nl ';'), 'Label')
          XDEAD = 'ZZZNOTPRESENT'
          Stmt3 = *Label
+                 ( *White *XDEAD
+                 | shf9(epsilon, '') shf9(epsilon, '') shf9(epsilon, '') shf9(epsilon, '')
+                 )
+                 FENCE(*Goto2 | shf9(epsilon, '') shf9(epsilon, ''))
+                 *Gray
          Command = *Stmt3 ("'S'" @ 7) (nl | ';')
          Parse = nPush() ARBNO(*Command) nPop2()
          Space = SPAN(' ' tab) | epsilon
          Src = 'START' nl
          Src POS(0) *Parse *Space RPOS(0)                :F(NO)
          OUTPUT = 'match'                                :(DONE)
NO        OUTPUT = 'nomatch'
DONE
END
```

```SNOBOL4
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* CLAWS5(N) -- rebuild the num -> word -> tag -> count table N times from the
* slurped corpus and report the bytes matched.  mem is cleared each pass so every

        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
```

## user_function_eval_arbno_replace_branch_1

```SNOBOL4
* json -- TIME-BASED: fixed ms budget, count iterations.
* workload: 631 KB of twitter.json parsed into real TABLEs/ARRAYs; check is the full node census.
* DESERIALIZING -- the -match sibling runs the same grammar with NO captures; the delta
* between them is the cost of the sprinkled loads (capture + *function() + structure build).
* Every OUTPUT in the original driver is accumulated into the check value instead of printed,
* so the check witnesses every value computed, not merely that the match succeeded.
* input: json.dat on stdin (runner redirects <family>.dat).
        &STLIMIT =  -1
        ZCHK    =   1
        ZBUD    =   1000
        ZFLR    =   20
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* json.sno - JSON DE-SERIALIZER: RFC-8259 text -> native SNOBOL4 data structures.
* ENG 685, Lon Cherryholmes Sr.
*
* This is the WORK member of the json family (json-match.sno / json-match-fence.sno
* are the recognize-only members: same grammar, zero side effects).  Here the ONE
* BIG pattern match carries deferred semantic actions that BUILD the data:
*
*     JSON object  ->  TABLE, keyed by member name   (wrapped in jobj so that
*                      insertion order is retained for deterministic output)
*     JSON array   ->  ARRAY(1..n), one-origin
*     JSON number  ->  INTEGER  (no fraction, no exponent)
*                      REAL     (fraction or exponent present)
*     JSON string  ->  STRING   (escapes decoded, \uXXXX -> UTF-8)
*     true / false ->  STRING 'true' / 'false'
*     null         ->  the null string
*
* Values are reduced on a shift/reduce value stack: a frame records the stack
* base at '{' or '[', and the close brace pops everything above that base into
* one TABLE or ARRAY.  No per-frame allocation, so cost is O(nodes), not O(depth
* * nodes).  All deferred actions are DIRECT (epsilon . *f()) - none are built
* through EVAL, so the run-time-compiled and compile-time-built deferred forms
* are never mixed in one program.
*
* Run: scrip --run json.sno < citm_catalog.json
*      sbl -b -d512m -i64m -s256m json.sno < citm_catalog.json
*      snobol4 -b -f -d 8m -P 4m -S 4m json.sno < citm_catalog.json
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                bslash          =   CHAR(92)
                tabch           =   CHAR(9)
                lf              =   CHAR(10)
                cr              =   CHAR(13)
                dq              =   '"'
                dig             =   '0123456789'
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DATA('jobj(otab,okeys,onum)')
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  Value stack (shift/reduce), key stack, and frame stack.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                VMAX            =   262144
                DMAX            =   4096
                vs              =   ARRAY(VMAX)
                ks              =   ARRAY(VMAX)
                fkd             =   ARRAY(DMAX)
                fvb             =   ARRAY(DMAX)
                fkb             =   ARRAY(DMAX)
                vsp             =   0
                ksp             =   0
                dep             =   0
                maxdep          =   0
                nObj            =   0
                nArr            =   0
                nStr            =   0
                nInt            =   0
                nReal           =   0
                nBool           =   0
                nNull           =   0
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  Escape and hex lookup tables.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                esc             =   TABLE()
                esc[dq]         =   dq
                esc[bslash]     =   bslash
                esc['/']        =   '/'
                esc['b']        =   CHAR(8)
                esc['f']        =   CHAR(12)
                esc['n']        =   lf
                esc['r']        =   cr
                esc['t']        =   tabch
                hxv             =   TABLE()
                hxs             =   '0123456789abcdef'
                hxi             =   0
hxlp            hxi             =   LT(hxi, 16) hxi + 1         :F(hxdone)
                hxc             =   SUBSTR(hxs, hxi, 1)
                hxv[hxc]        =   hxi - 1
                hxv[REPLACE(hxc, &LCASE, &UCASE)] = hxi - 1     :(hxlp)
hxdone
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  jutf8(n) - Unicode scalar -> UTF-8 byte string (BMP; surrogates passed through).
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('jutf8(n)')                              :(jutf8_end)

*  the capture dots and the deferred action epsilons.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```
