                jescape         =   bslash
+                                   ( ANY(dq '/bfnrt' bslash)
+                                   | 'u' ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF') ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF') ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF') ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF')
+                                   )
                jchunk          =   BREAK(dq bslash lf cr)
                jstrbody        =   jchunk ARBNO(jescape jchunk)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                jnumber         =   ( FENCE('-' | '')
+                                     ( '0' | ANY('123456789') FENCE(SPAN(dig) | '') )
+                                     FENCE('.' SPAN(dig) | '')
+                                     FENCE(ANY('eE') FENCE(ANY('+-') | '') SPAN(dig) | '')
+                                   ) . jxn
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                jkey            =   dq jstrbody . jxk dq (epsilon . *ekey())
                jstring         =   dq jstrbody . jxs dq (epsilon . *estr())
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                jmember         =   ws jkey ws ':' *jelement
                jobject         =   '{' (epsilon . *pobj())
+                                   ( jmember ARBNO(',' jmember) | ws )
+                                   '}' (epsilon . *eobj()) FENCE
                jarray          =   '[' (epsilon . *parr())
+                                   ( *jelement ARBNO(',' *jelement) | ws )
+                                   ']' (epsilon . *earr()) FENCE
                jvalue          =   jstring
+                                   | jnumber (epsilon . *enum())
+                                   | jobject
+                                   | jarray
+                                   | 'true'  (epsilon . *etru())
+                                   | 'false' (epsilon . *efal())
+                                   | 'null'  (epsilon . *enul())

                json            =   POS(0) jelement RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                &TRIM           =   0
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  READ ALL AT ONCE - .INPUT is re-associated raw on fd 0 with a 4 MiB record
*  length, so a single reference transfers the whole input in one read, byte
*  for byte (no line splitting, no newline reconstruction).  Inputs larger
*  than 4194304 bytes are silently truncated at the -r length.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
        ZSRC    =   INPUT
        DEFINE('ZBODY(ZKN)')                            :(ZBODY_END)
ZBODY   ZI      =   1
ZBL     vsp     =   0
        ksp     =   0
        dep     =   0
        maxdep  =   0
        nObj    =   0
        nArr    =   0
        nStr    =   0
        nInt    =   0
        nReal   =   0
        nBool   =   0
        nNull   =   0
        ZSRC    ?   json                                :F(ZBAD)
        ZI      =   LT(ZI, ZKN) ZI + 1                  :S(ZBL)
        ZBODY   =   nObj '/' nArr '/' nStr '/' nInt '/' nReal '/' nBool '/' nNull '/' maxdep
+                                                       :(RETURN)
ZBAD    ZBODY   =   'MATCH-FAILED'                      :(RETURN)
ZBODY_END
*	PT-J WALL 1 (s169): ZERO ARBNO iterations complete; the FIRST ARBNO iteration over the
*	deferred (*) body NEVER RETURNS.  `["s"]` has no comma so ARBNO never fires -- it matches
*	in ~1.1 s.  `["s","s"]` fires it ONCE and the program does not come back.
*	⛔ SCRIP DOES NOT TERMINATE ON THE SECOND MATCH.  Measured s169: still spinning at
*	   4 min 11 s, RSS FLAT at 28 MB (control-flow loop, NOT allocation growth); 420 s budget,
*	   no completion; 5 of 5 clean runs timed out.  ⛔ NEVER wire into a gate without a timeout.
*	⛔ The pure-grammar sibling (json-match.sno) does NOT hang on this input -- it has its own
*	   defect (SIGSEGV on any non-empty object).  The hang needs THIS grammar, the one with
*	   the captures, which is why this witness carries it whole: reduction FAILED this seat.
	ZSRC = '["s"]'
	OUTPUT = 'one-element ' ZBODY(1)
	ZSRC = '["s","s"]'
	OUTPUT = 'two-element ' ZBODY(1)
END

*      sbl -b -d512m -i64m -s256m json.sno < citm_catalog.json
*      snobol4 -b -f -d 8m -P 4m -S 4m json.sno < citm_catalog.json
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                bslash          =   CHAR(92)
                tabch           =   CHAR(9)
                lf              =   CHAR(10)
                cr              =   CHAR(13)
                dq              =   '"'
                dig             =   '0123456789'
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DATA('jobj(otab,okeys,onum)')
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  Value stack (shift/reduce), key stack, and frame stack.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                VMAX            =   262144
                DMAX            =   4096
                vs              =   ARRAY(VMAX)
                ks              =   ARRAY(VMAX)
                fkd             =   ARRAY(DMAX)
                fvb             =   ARRAY(DMAX)
                fkb             =   ARRAY(DMAX)
                vsp             =   0
                ksp             =   0
                dep             =   0
                maxdep          =   0
                nObj            =   0
                nArr            =   0
                nStr            =   0
                nInt            =   0
                nReal           =   0
                nBool           =   0
                nNull           =   0
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  Escape and hex lookup tables.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                esc             =   TABLE()
                esc[dq]         =   dq
                esc[bslash]     =   bslash
                esc['/']        =   '/'
                esc['b']        =   CHAR(8)
                esc['f']        =   CHAR(12)
                esc['n']        =   lf
                esc['r']        =   cr
                esc['t']        =   tabch
                hxv             =   TABLE()
                hxs             =   '0123456789abcdef'
                hxi             =   0
hxlp            hxi             =   LT(hxi, 16) hxi + 1         :F(hxdone)
                hxc             =   SUBSTR(hxs, hxi, 1)
                hxv[hxc]        =   hxi - 1
                hxv[REPLACE(hxc, &LCASE, &UCASE)] = hxi - 1     :(hxlp)
hxdone
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  jutf8(n) - Unicode scalar -> UTF-8 byte string (BMP; surrogates passed through).
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('jutf8(n)')                              :(jutf8_end)
jutf8           LT(n, 128)                                      :F(jutf8_2)
                jutf8           =   CHAR(n)                     :(RETURN)
jutf8_2         LT(n, 2048)                                     :F(jutf8_3)
                jutf8           =   CHAR(192 + (n / 64)) CHAR(128 + REMDR(n, 64))
+                                                               :(RETURN)
jutf8_3         jutf8           =   CHAR(224 + (n / 4096))
+                                   CHAR(128 + REMDR(n / 64, 64))
+                                   CHAR(128 + REMDR(n, 64))    :(RETURN)
jutf8_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  jdec(s) - decode JSON string escapes.  Fast path returns s untouched when the
*  literal held no backslash at all, which is the common case by a wide margin.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('jdec(s)r,seg,ec,hx,n')                  :(jdec_end)
jdec            s               bslash                          :F(jdec_fast)
                r               =
jdec_lp         s               FENCE (BREAK(bslash) | '') . seg bslash LEN(1) . ec =
+                                                               :F(jdec_done)
                r               =   r seg
                IDENT(ec, 'u')                                  :S(jdec_u)
                r               =   r esc[ec]                   :(jdec_lp)
jdec_u          s               FENCE LEN(4) . hx =             :F(jdec_done)
                n               =   ((hxv[SUBSTR(hx, 1, 1)] * 16 + hxv[SUBSTR(hx, 2, 1)]) * 16
+                                   + hxv[SUBSTR(hx, 3, 1)]) * 16 + hxv[SUBSTR(hx, 4, 1)]
                r               =   r jutf8(n)                  :(jdec_lp)
jdec_done       jdec            =   r s                         :(RETURN)
jdec_fast       jdec            =   s                           :(RETURN)
jdec_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  Value-stack shift.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('vpush(v)')                              :(vpush_end)
vpush           vsp             =   vsp + 1
                GT(vsp, VMAX)                                   :S(voflo)
                vs[vsp]         =   v
                vpush           =   .dummy                      :(RETURN)
voflo           OUTPUT          =   'json.sno: value stack overflow at ' vsp
                vpush           =   .dummy                      :(RETURN)
vpush_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  Deferred semantic actions - ALL direct (epsilon . *f()), none via EVAL.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('pobj()')                                :(pobj_end)
pobj            dep             =   dep + 1
                maxdep          =   GT(dep, maxdep) dep
                maxdep          =   maxdep
                fkd[dep]        =   'O'
                fvb[dep]        =   vsp
                fkb[dep]        =   ksp
                pobj            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
pobj_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('parr()')                                :(parr_end)
parr            dep             =   dep + 1
                maxdep          =   GT(dep, maxdep) dep
                maxdep          =   maxdep
                fkd[dep]        =   'A'
                fvb[dep]        =   vsp
                fkb[dep]        =   ksp
                parr            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
parr_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('ekey()')                                :(ekey_end)
ekey            ksp             =   ksp + 1
                ks[ksp]         =   jdec(jxk)
                ekey            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
ekey_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('eobj()vb,kb,n,t,ka,i')                  :(eobj_end)
eobj            vb              =   fvb[dep]
                kb              =   fkb[dep]
                n               =   vsp - vb
                t               =   TABLE()
                ka              =   ARRAY(GT(n, 0) n)           :F(eobj_empty)
                i               =   0
eobj_lp         i               =   LT(i, n) i + 1              :F(eobj_fin)
                ka[i]           =   ks[kb + i]
                t[ka[i]]        =   vs[vb + i]                  :(eobj_lp)
eobj_empty      ka              =   ARRAY(1)
eobj_fin        vsp             =   vb
                ksp             =   kb
                dep             =   dep - 1
                nObj            =   nObj + 1
                dummy           =   vpush(jobj(t, ka, n))
                eobj            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
eobj_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('earr()vb,n,a,i')                        :(earr_end)
earr            vb              =   fvb[dep]
                n               =   vsp - vb
                a               =   ARRAY(GT(n, 0) n)           :F(earr_empty)
                i               =   0
earr_lp         i               =   LT(i, n) i + 1              :F(earr_fin)
                a[i]            =   vs[vb + i]                  :(earr_lp)
earr_empty      a               =   ARRAY(1)
earr_fin        vsp             =   vb
                dep             =   dep - 1
                nArr            =   nArr + 1
                dummy           =   vpush(a)
                earr            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
earr_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('estr()')                                :(estr_end)
estr            nStr            =   nStr + 1
                dummy           =   vpush(jdec(jxs))
                estr            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
estr_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  INTEGER when the literal carried neither fraction nor exponent, else REAL.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('enum()')                                :(enum_end)
enum            jxn             ANY('.eE')                      :S(enum_real)
                nInt            =   nInt + 1
                dummy           =   vpush(CONVERT(jxn, 'INTEGER'))
                enum            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
enum_real       nReal           =   nReal + 1
                dummy           =   vpush(CONVERT(jxn, 'REAL'))
                enum            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
enum_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('etru()')                                :(etru_end)
etru            nBool           =   nBool + 1
                dummy           =   vpush('true')
                etru            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
etru_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('efal()')                                :(efal_end)
efal            nBool           =   nBool + 1
                dummy           =   vpush('false')
                efal            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
efal_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                DEFINE('enul()')                                :(enul_end)
enul            nNull           =   nNull + 1
                dummy           =   vpush(NULL)
                enul            =   .dummy                      :(NRETURN)
enul_end
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  THE GRAMMAR - RFC 8259.  Same shape as json-match.sno; the only additions are
*  the capture dots and the deferred action epsilons.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                ws              =   FENCE(SPAN(' ' tabch lf cr) | '')
                jescape         =   bslash
+                                   ( ANY(dq '/bfnrt' bslash)
+                                   | 'u' ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF') ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF') ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF') ANY('0123456789abcdefABCDEF')
+                                   )
                jchunk          =   BREAK(dq bslash lf cr)
                jstrbody        =   jchunk ARBNO(jescape jchunk)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                jnumber         =   ( FENCE('-' | '')
+                                     ( '0' | ANY('123456789') FENCE(SPAN(dig) | '') )
+                                     FENCE('.' SPAN(dig) | '')
+                                     FENCE(ANY('eE') FENCE(ANY('+-') | '') SPAN(dig) | '')
+                                   ) . jxn
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                jkey            =   dq jstrbody . jxk dq FENCE (epsilon . *ekey())
                jstring         =   dq jstrbody . jxs dq FENCE (epsilon . *estr())
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                jmember         =   ws jkey ws ':' *jelement
                jobject         =   '{' (epsilon . *pobj())
+                                   ( jmember ARBNO(',' jmember) | ws )
+                                   '}' (epsilon . *eobj()) FENCE
                jarray          =   '[' (epsilon . *parr())
+                                   ( *jelement ARBNO(',' *jelement) | ws )
+                                   ']' (epsilon . *earr()) FENCE
                jvalue          =   jstring
+                                   | jnumber (epsilon . *enum())
+                                   | jobject
+                                   | jarray
+                                   | 'true'  (epsilon . *etru())
+                                   | 'false' (epsilon . *efal())
+                                   | 'null'  (epsilon . *enul())
                jelement        =   ws *jvalue ws
                json            =   POS(0) jelement RPOS(0)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                &TRIM           =   0
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  READ ALL AT ONCE - .INPUT is re-associated raw on fd 0 with a 4 MiB record
*  length, so a single reference transfers the whole input in one read, byte
*  for byte (no line splitting, no newline reconstruction).  Inputs larger
*  than 4194304 bytes are silently truncated at the -r length.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* JSON(N) -- deserialize the slurped text N times and report the node census.
* Every counter and both stacks are reset per pass, so each pass does the same
* work and the census is the census of ONE parse, not of N accumulated ones.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DEFINE('JSON(N)')  :(JSON_END)
JSON    ZI = 1
ZBL     vsp = 0
        ksp = 0
        dep = 0
        maxdep = 0
        nObj = 0
        nArr = 0
        nStr = 0
        nInt = 0
        nReal = 0
        nBool = 0
        nNull = 0
        src json  :F(ZBAD)
        ZI = LT(ZI, N) ZI + 1  :S(ZBL)
        JSON = nObj '/' nArr '/' nStr '/' nInt '/' nReal '/' nBool '/' nNull '/' maxdep
+                                                       :(RETURN)
ZBAD    JSON = 'Pattern match failed'  :(RETURN)
JSON_END
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INPUT(.INPUT, 9, '[-f0 -r4194304]')
        src             =   INPUT
*BENCH kernel=JSON check=1 bud=1000 flr=20
                OUTPUT          =   'input bytes=' SIZE(src)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  THE ONE BIG PATTERN MATCH - timed alone.  TIME() is integer nanoseconds off a
*  monotonic wall clock (FINDING s249), so t1 - t0 is the match only: no slurp,
*  no reporting, no start-up; divide by 1000000 for match_ms, same idiom as
*  harness.inc's "ms:" line.  Written to TERMINAL, i.e. stderr, so that stdout
*  stays deterministic and byte-comparable against .ref.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                t0              =   TIME()
                src             json                            :F(fail)
                t1              =   TIME()
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                root            =   vs[1]
                OUTPUT          =   'root=' DATATYPE(root)
                OUTPUT          =   'objects=' nObj
                OUTPUT          =   'arrays=' nArr
                OUTPUT          =   'strings=' nStr
                OUTPUT          =   'integers=' nInt
                OUTPUT          =   'reals=' nReal
                OUTPUT          =   'booleans=' nBool
                OUTPUT          =   'nulls=' nNull
                OUTPUT          =   'maxdepth=' maxdep
                TERMINAL        =   'match_ms=' (t1 - t0) / 1000000       :(END)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
fail            t1              =   TIME()
                OUTPUT          =   'Pattern match failed'
                TERMINAL        =   'match_ms=' (t1 - t0) / 1000000
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
END

* Program:       SNOBOL4 Beautifier

START

                  &FULLSCAN      =  1
                  &MAXLNGTH      =  524288
*
*                 Four tab-stops defined for the pretty-print routine.
*                 ppStop[1] - subject
*                 ppStop[2] - pattern or =
*                 ppStop[3] - object of assignment
*                 ppStop[4] - goto field
*                 ppSmBump - the amount of extra space when within multi-line nesting
*                 ppLgBump - the amount of extra space when no goto field is present
*
                  ppStop         =  ARRAY('1:4')
                  ppStop[1]      =  18
                  ppStop[2]      =  33
                  ppStop[3]      =  36
                  ppStop[4]      =  81
                  ppSmBump       =  6
                  ppLgBump       =  21
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
*                 Parser patterns:

                  Integer        =  SPAN(digits)
                  DQ             =  '"' BREAK('"' nl) '"'
                  SQ             =  "'" BREAK("'" nl) "'"
                  String         =  *SQ | *DQ
                  Real           =  ( SPAN(digits)
+                                     ('.' FENCE(SPAN(digits) | epsilon) | epsilon)
+                                     ('E' | 'e')
+                                     ('+' | '-' | epsilon)
+                                     SPAN(digits)
+                                   | SPAN(digits) '.' FENCE(SPAN(digits) | epsilon)
+                                   )
                  Id             =  ANY(&UCASE &LCASE) FENCE(SPAN('.' digits &UCASE '_' &LCASE) | epsilon)
                  Function       =  SPAN('.' digits &UCASE '_' &LCASE) $ tx $ *match(Functions, TxInList)
                  BuiltinVar     =  SPAN('.' digits &UCASE '_' &LCASE) $ tx $ *match(BuiltinVars, TxInList)
                  SpecialNm      =  SPAN('.' digits &UCASE '_' &LCASE) $ tx $ *match(SpecialNms, TxInList)
                  ProtKwd        =  '&' SPAN(&UCASE &LCASE) $ tx $ *match(ProtKwds, TxInList)
                  UnprotKwd      =  '&' SPAN(&UCASE &LCASE) $ tx $ *match(UnprotKwds, TxInList)

                  Gray           =  *White | epsilon
                  White          =  ( SPAN(' ' tab)
+                                     FENCE(nl ('+' | '.') FENCE(SPAN(' ' tab) | epsilon) | epsilon)
+                                   | nl ('+' | '.') FENCE(SPAN(' ' tab) | epsilon)
+                                   )

                  TxInList       =  (POS(0) | ' ') *upr(tx) (' ' | RPOS(0))
                  SpecialNms     =  'ABORT CONTINUE END FRETURN NRETURN RETURN SCONTINUE START'
                  BuiltinVars    =  'ABORT ARB BAL FAIL FENCE INPUT OUTPUT REM TERMINAL'
                  ProtKwds       =  'ABORT ALPHABET ARB BAL FAIL FENCE FILE FNCLEVEL '
+                                   'LASTFILE LASTLINE LASTNO LCASE LINE REM RTNTYPE '
+                                   'STCOUNT STNO SUCCEED UCASE'
                  UnprotKwds     =  'ABEND ANCHOR CASE CODE COMPARE DUMP ERRLIMIT '
+                                   'ERRTEXT ERRTYPE FTRACE INPUT MAXLNGTH OUTPUT '
+                                   'PROFILE STLIMIT TRACE TRIM FULLSCAN'
                  Functions      =  'ANY APPLY ARBNO ARG ARRAY ATAN BACKSPACE BREAK BREAKX '
+                                   'CHAR CHOP CLEAR CODE COLLECT CONVERT COPY COS DATA '
+                                   'DATATYPE DATE DEFINE DETACH DIFFER DUMP DUPL EJECT '
+                                   'ENDFILE EQ EVAL EXIT EXP FENCE FIELD GE GT HOST '
+                                   'IDENT INPUT INTEGER ITEM LE LEN LEQ LGE LGT LLE '
+                                   'LLT LN LNE LOAD LOCAL LPAD LT NE NOTANY OPSYN OUTPUT '
+                                   'POS PROTOTYPE REMDR REPLACE REVERSE REWIND RPAD RPOS '
+                                   'RSORT RTAB SET SETEXIT SIN SIZE SORT SPAN SQRT STOPTR '
+                                   'SUBSTR TAB TABLE TAN TIME TRACE TRIM UNLOAD'

                  $'='           =  *White '=' *White
                  $'?'           =  *White '?' *White
                  $'|'           =  *White '|' *White
                  $'+'           =  *White '+' *White
                  $'-'           =  *White '-' *White
                  $'/'           =  *White '/' *White
                  $'*'           =  *White '*' *White
                  $'^'           =  *White '^' *White
                  $'!'           =  *White '!' *White
                  $'**'          =  *White '**' *White
                  $'$'           =  *White '$' *White
                  $'.'           =  *White '.' *White
                  $'&'           =  *White '&' *White
                  $'@'           =  *White '@' *White
                  $'#'           =  *White '#' *White
                  $'%'           =  *White '%' *White
                  $'~'           =  *White '~' *White

                  $'('           =  '(' *Gray
                  $'['           =  '[' *Gray

                  $')'           =  *Gray ')'
                  $']'           =  *Gray ']'
                  $'>'           =  *Gray '>'

                  ExprList       =  nPush()
+                                   *XList
+                                   (epsilon . *Reduce('ExprList', *(GT(nTop(), 1) nTop())))

                  XList          =  nInc()
+                                   (*Expr | epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx))
+                                   FENCE($',' *XList | epsilon)
                  Expr           =  *Expr0
                  Expr0          =  *Expr1 FENCE($'=' *Expr0 (epsilon . *Reduce('=', 2)) | epsilon)
                  Expr1          =  *Expr2 FENCE($'?' *Expr1 (epsilon . *Reduce('?', 2)) | epsilon)
                  Expr2          =  *Expr3 FENCE($'&' *Expr2 (epsilon . *Reduce('&', 2)) | epsilon)
                  Expr3          =  nPush() *X3 (epsilon . *Reduce('|', *(GT(nTop(), 1) nTop()))) nPop()
                  X3             =  nInc() *Expr4 FENCE($'|' *X3 | epsilon)
                  Expr4          =  nPush() *X4 (epsilon . *Reduce('..', *(GT(nTop(), 1) nTop()))) nPop()
                  X4             =  nInc() *Expr5 FENCE(*White *X4 | epsilon)
                  Expr5          =  *Expr6 FENCE($'@' *Expr5 (epsilon . *Reduce('@', 2)) | epsilon)
                  Expr6          =  *Expr7
+                                   FENCE(
+                                     $'+' *Expr6 (epsilon . *Reduce('+', 2))

                  Expr7          =  *Expr8 FENCE($'#' *Expr7 (epsilon . *Reduce('#', 2)) | epsilon)
                  Expr8          =  *Expr9 FENCE($'/' *Expr8 (epsilon . *Reduce('/', 2)) | epsilon)
                  Expr9          =  *Expr10 FENCE($'*' *Expr9 (epsilon . *Reduce('*', 2)) | epsilon)
                  Expr10         =  *Expr11 FENCE($'%' *Expr10 (epsilon . *Reduce('%', 2)) | epsilon)
                  Expr11         =  *Expr12
+                                   FENCE(
+                                     ($'^' | $'!' | $'**') *Expr11 (epsilon . *Reduce('^', 2))
+                                   | epsilon
+                                   )
                  Expr12         =  *Expr13
+                                   FENCE(
+                                     $'$' *Expr12 (epsilon . *Reduce('$', 2))
+                                   | $'.' *Expr12 (epsilon . *Reduce('.', 2))
+                                   | epsilon
+                                   )
                  Expr13         =  *Expr14 FENCE($'~' *Expr13 (epsilon . *Reduce('~', 2)) | epsilon)
                  Expr14         =  '@' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('@', 1))
+                                 | '~' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('~', 1))
+                                 | '?' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('?', 1))
+                                 | *ProtKwd . thx . *Shift('ProtKwd', thx)
+                                 | *UnprotKwd . thx . *Shift('UnprotKwd', thx)
+                                 | '&' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('&', 1))
+                                 | '+' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('+', 1))
+                                 | '-' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('-', 1))
+                                 | '*' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('*', 1))
+                                 | '$' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('$', 1))
+                                 | '.' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('.', 1))
+                                 | '!' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('!', 1))
+                                 | '%' *Expr14 (epsilon . *Reduce('%', 1))

                  SGoto          =  ('S' | 's') . *assign(.sf, *'S')
                  FGoto          =  ('F' | 'f') . *assign(.sf, *'F')

                  Comment        =  '*' BREAK(nl)

+                                   ( *White

+                                       | '=' . thx . *Shift('=', thx) epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                       )
+                                     | ($'?' | *White)
+                                       *Expr1
+                                       FENCE(
+                                         *White
+                                         ( '=' . thx . *Shift('=', thx) *White *Expr
+                                         | '=' . thx . *Shift('=', thx) epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                         )
+                                       | epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx) epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                       )
+                                     | epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                       epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                       epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                     )
+                                   | epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                     epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                     epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                     epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                   )
+                                   FENCE(
+                                     *Goto
+                                   | epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx) epsilon . thx . *Shift('', thx)
+                                   )
+                                   *Gray

                  Commands       =  *Command FENCE(*Commands | epsilon)
                  Command        =  nInc()
+                                   FENCE(
+                                     *Comment . thx . *Shift('comment', thx)
+                                     (epsilon . *Reduce('Comment', 1))
+                                     nl
+                                   | *Control . thx . *Shift('control', thx)
+                                     (epsilon . *Reduce('Control', 1))
+                                     (nl | ';')
+                                   | *Stmt (epsilon . *Reduce('Stmt', 7)) (nl | ';')
+                                   )

                  Parse          =  nPush() ARBNO(*Command) (epsilon . *Reduce('Parse', nTop())) nPop()

                  Compiland      =  nPush()
+                                   ARBNO(*Command)
+                                   (epsilon . *Reduce('Parse', nTop()))
+                                   ( icase('END') (' ' BREAK(nl) nl | nl) ARBNO(BREAK(nl) nl)
+                                   | epsilon
+                                   )
+                                   nPop()

*                 Pretty-print routine.
*                 null = pp(x=tree)
*                 Recursive routine given a tree, to output SNOBOL4 code.

                  DEFINE('pp(x)c,i,n,s,t,v')                                     :(ppEnd)
pp                DIFFER(x)                                                      :F(RETURN)
                  t              =  t(x)
                  v              =  v(x)
                  n              =  n(x)
                  c              =  c(x)
                  OUTPUT         =  GT(doDebug, 0) 'pp(' t ')' ', sz = ' level '+' SIZE(v) ', v = ' v
                  DIFFER(t)                                                      :S($('pp_' t))F(RETURN)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_Parse          ppWidth        =  ppStop[4]                                    :(pp_0)
pp_0              i              =  0
pp_1              i              =  LT(i, n) i + 1                               :F(RETURN)
                  pp(c[i])                                                       :(pp_1)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_BuiltinVar     Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_Function       Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_Id             Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_Integer        Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_Label          Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_ProtKwd        Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_Real           Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_SpecialNm      Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_String         Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_UnprotKwd      Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_:()            Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_:<>            Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_:S()           Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_:S<>           Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_:F()           Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
pp_:F<>           Gen(ss(x))                                                     :S(RETURN)F(error)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
ppUnOp            Gen(ss(x, ppWidth - GetLevel()))                               :S(RETURN)
                  Gen(t)
                  pp(c[1])                                                       :(RETURN)
ppBinOp           Gen(ss(x, ppWidth - GetLevel()))                               :S(RETURN)
                  pp(c[1])
                  Gen(nl)
                  DecLevel()
                  Gen(t)
                  IncLevel()
                  GenTab()
                  pp(c[2])                                                       :(RETURN)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_!              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
pp_#              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_$              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_%              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_&              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_*              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_+              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_-              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_.              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_/              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_=              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_?              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_@              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_^              EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
pp_~              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  EQ(n, 2)                                                       :S(ppBinOp)F(error)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_Comment        SetLevel(0)
                  GenSetCont()
                  Gen(v(c[1]) nl)                                                :(RETURN)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_Control        SetLevel(0)
                  GenSetCont()
                  Gen(v(c[1]) nl)                                                :(RETURN)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_Stmt           SetLevel(0)
                  GenSetCont('+')
                  ppWidth        =  ppStop[4]
                  ppLbl          =  ss(c[1])
                  ppSubj         =  c[2]
                  ppPatrn        =  c[3]
                  ppAsgn         =  v(c[4])
                  ppRepl         =  c[5]
                  ppGo1          =  c[6]
                  ppGo2          =  c[7]
                  Gen(ppLbl)
                  DIFFER(t(ppSubj))                                              :F(pp_Stmt7)
                  Gen(' ')
                  GenTab(ppStop[1])
                  SetLevel(ppStop[1])
                  ppWidth        =  IDENT(t(ppPatrn))
+                                   IDENT(ppAsgn)
+                                   IDENT(t(ppGo1))
+                                   ppStop[4] + ppLgBump
                  pp(ppSubj)
                  DIFFER(t(ppPatrn))                                             :F(pp_Stmt5)
                  Gen(' ')
                  GenTab(ppStop[2])
                  SetLevel(ppStop[2])
                  ppWidth        =  IDENT(ppAsgn) IDENT(t(ppGo1)) ppStop[4] + ppLgBump
                  pp(ppPatrn)
                  DIFFER(ppAsgn)                                                 :F(pp_Stmt7)
                  Gen(' =')
                  DIFFER(t(ppRepl))                                              :F(pp_Stmt7)
                  Gen(' ')
                  pp(ppRepl)                                                     :(pp_Stmt7)
pp_Stmt5          DIFFER(ppAsgn)                                                 :F(pp_Stmt7)
                  Gen(' ')
                  GenTab(ppStop[2])
                  SetLevel(ppStop[2])
                  Gen('=')
                  DIFFER(t(ppRepl))                                              :F(pp_Stmt7)
                  Gen(' ')
                  GenTab(ppStop[3])
                  SetLevel(ppStop[3])
                  ppWidth        =  IDENT(t(ppGo1)) ppStop[4] + ppLgBump
                  pp(ppRepl)                                                     :(pp_Stmt7)
pp_Stmt7          DIFFER(t(ppGo1))                                               :F(pp_Stmt9)
                  ppWidth        =  256
                  Gen(' ')
                  GenTab(ppStop[4])
                  SetLevel(ppStop[4])
                  Gen(':')
                  pp(ppGo1)
                  DIFFER(t(ppGo2))                                               :F(pp_Stmt9)
                  pp(ppGo2)                                                      :(pp_Stmt9)
pp_Stmt9          Gen(nl)                                                        :(RETURN)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_ExprList       Gen(ss(x, ppWidth - GetLevel()))                               :S(RETURN)
                  pp(c[1])
                  i              =  1
pp_ExprList0      i              =  LT(i, n) i + 1                               :F(RETURN)
                  Gen(nl)
                  DecLevel()
                  Gen(',')
                  IncLevel()
                  GenTab()
                  pp(c[i])                                                       :(pp_ExprList0)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_,              Gen(ss(x, ppWidth - GetLevel()))                               :S(RETURN)

                  GenTab()

pp_,0             i              =  LT(i, n) i + 1                               :F($'pp_,1')

                  IncLevel()
                  GenTab()
                  pp(c[i])                                                       :($'pp_,0')
pp_,1             Gen(nl)
                  DecLevel()
                  Gen(')')                                                       :(RETURN)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_|              EQ(n, 1)                                                       :S(ppUnOp)
                  Gen(ss(x, ppWidth - GetLevel()))                               :S(RETURN)
                  pp(c[1])
                  i              =  1
pp_|0             i              =  LT(i, n) i + 1                               :F(RETURN)
                  Gen(nl)
                  DecLevel()
                  Gen('|')
                  IncLevel()
                  GenTab()
                  pp(c[i])                                                       :($'pp_|0')
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_..             Gen(ss(x, ppWidth - GetLevel()))                               :S(RETURN)
                  i              =  0
pp_..0            i              =  LT(i, n) i + 1                               :F(RETURN)
                  pp(c[i])
                  (LT(i, n) Gen(nl))                                             :($'pp_..0')
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_[]             Gen(ss(x, ppWidth - GetLevel()))                               :S(RETURN)
                  pp(c[1])
                  i              =  1
pp_[]0            i              =  LT(i, n) i + 1                               :F(RETURN)

                  IncLevel()
                  GenTab()
                  pp(c[i])
                  Gen(nl)
                  DecLevel()
                  Gen(']')

*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
pp_()             Gen(ss(x, ppWidth - GetLevel()))                               :S(RETURN)
                  Gen('(')
                  IncLevel()
                  GenTab()
                  pp(c[1])
                  Gen(nl)

                  Gen(')')                                                       :(RETURN)

pp_Call           Gen(ss(x, ppWidth - GetLevel()))                               :S(RETURN)

*                 Recursive function given a tree, to return SNOBOL4 code as a string.
*
                  DEFINE('ss(x,len)c,c1,c2,i,n,s,t,v')                           :(ssEnd)
ss                DIFFER(x)                                                      :F(RETURN)

                  t              =  t(x)
                  v              =  v(x)
                  n              =  n(x)

*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------

ss_Function       ss             =  upr(v)                                       :(ss_atomic)
ss_Id             ss             =  v                                            :(ss_atomic)
ss_Integer        ss             =  v                                            :(ss_atomic)
ss_Label          v              POS(0) *SpecialNm RPOS(0)                       :S(ss_Label0)F(ss_Label1)
ss_Label0         ss             =  upr(v)                                       :(ss_atomic)
ss_Label1         ss             =  v                                            :(ss_atomic)
ss_ProtKwd        ss             =  upr(v)                                       :(ss_atomic)
ss_Real           ss             =  v                                            :(ss_atomic)
ss_SpecialNm      ss             =  upr(v)                                       :(ss_atomic)
ss_String         ss             =  v                                            :(ss_atomic)
ss_UnprotKwd      ss             =  upr(v)                                       :(ss_atomic)
ss_atomic         LE(SIZE(ss), len)                                              :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
ss_:()            ss             =  '(' ss(c[1], len - 2) ')'                    :S(RETURN)F(error)
ss_:<>            ss             =  '<' ss(c[1], len - 2) '>'                    :S(RETURN)F(error)
ss_:S()           ss             =  'S(' ss(c[1], len - 3) ')'                   :S(RETURN)F(error)
ss_:S<>           ss             =  'S<' ss(c[1], len - 3) '>'                   :S(RETURN)F(error)
ss_:F()           ss             =  'F(' ss(c[1], len - 3) ')'                   :S(RETURN)F(error)
ss_:F<>           ss             =  'F<' ss(c[1], len - 3) '>'                   :S(RETURN)F(error)

ssUnOp            ss             =  t ss(c[1], len - SIZE(t))                    :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
ssBinOp           ss             =  ss(c[1], len)                                :F(FRETURN)

+                                   ' '
+                                   t
+                                   ' '

                  DEFINE('visit(x,fnc)i')                                        :(visitEnd)
visit             APPLY(fnc, x)                                                  :F(RETURN)

                  DEFINE('findRefs(x)n,v')
                  Refs           =                                               :(findRefsEnd)
findRefs          DIFFER(x)                                                      :F(RETURN)
                  IDENT(t(x), 'Call')                                            :F(findRefs_1)
                  n              =  1
findRefs_0        n              =  LT(n, n(x)) n + 1                            :F(FRETURN)
                  visit(c(x)[n], .findRefs)                                      :(findRefs_0)
findRefs_1        (IDENT(t(x), '&') EQ(n(x), 1))                                 :F(findRefs_2)
                  v              =  ss(x)                                        :(findRefs_9)
findRefs_2        IDENT(t(x), 'Id')                                              :F(RETURN)
                  v              =  v(x)                                         :(findRefs_9)
findRefs_9        v              POS(0) SPAN('0123456789' &UCASE '_') RPOS(0)    :F(FRETURN)
                  Refs           =  DIFFER(Refs) Refs ' ' v                      :S(FRETURN)
                  Refs           =  IDENT(Refs) v                                :(FRETURN)
findRefsEnd
*---------------- -------------- -- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------
                  DEFINE('refs(p)c,n,s,subj')                                    :(refsEnd)
refs              c              =  c(p)
                  n              =  0
refs_0            n              =  LT(n, n(p)) n + 1                            :F(RETURN)
                  IDENT(t(c[n]), 'Stmt')                                         :F(refs_0)
                  s              =  s + 1
                  IDENT(t(c(c[n])[3]))                                           :F(refs_0)
                  IDENT(t(c(c[n])[4]), '=')                                      :F(refs_0)
                  IDENT(t(c(c[n])[2]), 'Id')                                     :S(refs_1)
                  IDENT(t(c(c[n])[2]), '$')                                      :S(refs_1)F(refs_0)
refs_1            subj           =  ss(c(c[n])[2])
                  Refs           =
                  visit(c(c[n])[5], .findRefs)
                  OUTPUT         =  LPAD(s, 3, 0) ': ' RPAD(subj, 38) ' ' Refs   :(refs_0)
refsEnd
*================ ============== == =============================================== ========================
*                 Main program.
*                 Read a SNOBOL4 program.
*                 Parse the SNOBOL4 program.
*                 Generate a more beautiful SNOBOL4 program.
*
                  doDebug        =  0
                  Space          =  SPAN(' ' tab) | epsilon
main00            Line           =  INPUT                                        :F(END)
main01            Src            =
                  Line           POS(0) ANY('*-')                                :F(main02)
                  OUTPUT         =  Line                                         :(main00)
main02            Src            =  Src Line nl
                  Line           =  INPUT                                        :F(main05)
                  Line           POS(0) ANY('.+')                                :S(main02)
                  Src            POS(0) *Parse *Space RPOS(0)                    :F(mainErr1)
                  DIFFER(sno = Pop())                                            :F(mainErr2)
                  pp(sno)                                                        :(main01)
main05            Src            POS(0) *Parse *Space RPOS(0)                    :F(mainErr1)
                  DIFFER(sno = Pop())                                            :F(mainErr2)
                  pp(sno)                                                        :(END)
mainErr1          OUTPUT         =  'Parse Error'
                  OUTPUT         =  Src                                          :(END)
mainErr2          OUTPUT         =  'Internal Error'
                  OUTPUT         =  Src                                          :(END)
*-INCLUDE 'debug.sno'
END

      DEFINE('ROMAN(N)UNITS')  :(ROMAN_END)
ROMAN N RPOS(1) LEN(1) . UNITS =  :F(RETURN)
      '0,1I,2II,3III,4IV,5V,6VI,7VII,8VIII,9IX,' UNITS BREAK(',') . UNITS  :F(FRETURN)
      ROMAN = REPLACE(ROMAN(N),'IVXLCDM','XLCDM**') UNITS  :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
ROMAN_END
      DEFINE("TEST(I,J)")  :(TEST_END)
TEST  OUTPUT = I ' -> ' ROMAN(I)
      EQ(I,J)  :S(RETURN)
      I = I + 1  :(TEST)
TEST_END
      TEST(1,100)
      TEST(149,151)
      TEST(480,520)
      TEST(1900,2100)
END
